Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Tradent enim vos * in concíliis, et in synagógis suis flagellábunt vos, et ante reges et prǽsides ducémini propter me in testimónium illis, et Géntibus.
Ant 1.eng: For they shall deliver you * up to councils: and in the synagogues you shall be beaten: and you shall stand before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony unto them.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Vos qui reliquístis * ómnia, et secúti estis me, céntuplum accipiétis, et vitam ætérnam possidébitis.
Ant 2.eng: You who left all * and follow me, you will receive hundredfolds, and you will have eternal life.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Estóte fortes * in bello, et pugnáte cum antíquo serpénte: et accipiétis regnum ætérnum, allelúja.
Ant 3.eng: Be valiant * in battle, fight the ancient serpent and accept the eternal kingdom. Alleluia.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Fratres: Jam non estis hóspites et ádvenæ: sed estis cives Sanctórum et doméstici Dei: superædificáti super fundaméntum Apostolórum, et Prophetárum, ipso summo angulári lápide Christo Jesu.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Brothers: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners; but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and the domestics of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Ibant Apóstoli gaudéntes a conspéctu concílii, quóniam digni hábiti sunt pro nómine Jesu contuméliam pati.
Capitulum Nona.eng: V. And the Apostles indeed went from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were accounted worthy to suffer reproach for the name of Jesus.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Per manus autem Apostolórum fiébant signa et prodígia multa in plebe.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Exsúltet orbis gáudiis
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Exsúltet orbis gáudiis:
Cælum resúltet láudibus:
Apostolórum glóriam
Tellus et astra cóncinunt.

Vos sæculórum júdices,
Et vera mundi lúmina:
Votis precámur córdium,
Audíte voces súpplicum.

Qui templa cæli cláuditis,
Serásque verbo sólvitis,
Nos a reátu nóxios
Solvi jubéte, quǽsumus.

Præcépta quorum prótinus
Languor salúsque séntiunt:
Sanáte mentes lánguidas:
Augéte nos virtútibus.

Ut, cum redíbit árbiter
In fine Christus sǽculi,
Nos sempitérni gáudii
Concédat esse cómpotes.

Patri, simúlque Fílio,
Tibíque Sancte Spíritus,
Sicut fuit, sit júgiter
Sæclum per omne glória.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Now let the earth with joy resound,
And heaven the chant re-echo round;
Nor heaven nor earth too high can raise
The great Apostles' glorious praise.

O ye who, throned in glory dread,
Shall judge the living and the dead,
Lights of the world forevermore!
To you the suppliant prayer we pour.

Ye close the sacred gates on high;
At your command apart they fly:
Oh! loose for us the guilty chain
We strive to break, and strive in vain.

Sickness and health your voice obey;
At your command they go or stay:
From sin's disease our souls restore;
In good confirm us more and more.

So when the world is at its end,
And Christ to judgement shall descend,
May we be called those joys to see
Prepared from all eternity.

Praise to the Father, with the Son,
And Holy Spirit, Three in One;
As ever was in ages past,
And so shall be while ages last.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Ætérna Christi múnera
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Ætérna Christi múnera,
Apostolórum glóriam,
Palmas et hymnos débitos
Lætis canámus méntibus.

Ecclesiárum Príncipes,
Belli triumpháles duces,
Cæléstis aulæ mílites,
Et vera mundi lúmina.

Devóta Sanctórum fides,
Invícta spes credéntium,
Perfécta Christi cáritas
Mundi tyránnum cónterit.

In his Patérna glória,
In his triúmphat Fílius,
In his volúntas Spíritus,
Cælum replétur gáudio.

Patri, simúlque Fílio,
Tibíque Sancte Spíritus,
Sicut fuit, sit júgiter
Sæclum per omne glória.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
Th' eternal gifts of Christ the King,
The Apostles' glory, let us sing;
And all with hearts of gladness raise
Due hymns of thankful love and praise.

For they the Church's princes are,
Triumphant leaders in the war,
The heavenly King's own warrior band,
True lights to lighten every land.

Theirs was the steadfast faith of saints,
The hope that never yields nor faints,
The love of Christ in perfect glow,
That lay the prince of this world low.

In them the Father's glory shone,
In them the Spirit's will was done,
The Son himself exults in them;
Joy fills the new Jerusalem.

Praise to the Father, with the Son,
And Holy Spirit, Three in One;
As ever was in ages past,
And so shall be while ages last.
Amen.

Hymnus Vespera.title: Exsúltet orbis gáudiis

HymnusMMatutinumUS.label: Hymn
HymnusMMatutinumUS.title: Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus
HymnusMMatutinumUS.lat:
Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus,
Ut ipsórum consórtio
Jungas precántes sérvulos
In sempitérna sǽcula.
HymnusMMatutinumUS.eng:
Now to you, Redeemer, we ask:
That you might unite to the fellowship of those above
your servants at prayer here
Forever and ever more

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.eng: The Lord, the King of Apostles, * O come, let us adore.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Ibant Apóstoli gaudéntes a conspéctu concílii, quóniam digni hábiti sunt pro nómine Jesu contuméliam pati.
Lectio Prima.eng: V. And the Apostles indeed went from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were accounted worthy to suffer reproach for the name of Jesus.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.lat: ℣. Constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram.
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. Thou shalt make them princes over all the earth.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Nimis honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. Thy friends, O Lord, are made exceedingly honourable.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. Their principality is exceedingly strengthened.

Responsory Breve Nona.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Nona.lat:
℟.br. Nimis honoráti sunt * Amíci tui, Deus.
℣. Nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.
℟. Amíci tui, Deus.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Nimis honoráti sunt * Amíci tui, Deus.
Responsory Breve Nona.eng:
℟.br. Thy friends, O God * are made exceedingly honourable.
℣. Their principality is exceedingly strengthened.
℟. O God, thy friends.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Thy friends, O God * are made exceedingly honourable.

Responsory Breve Sexta.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Sexta.lat:
℟.br. Constítues eos príncipes * Super omnem terram.
℣. Mémores erunt nóminis tui, Dómine.
℟. Super omnem terram.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Constítues eos príncipes * Super omnem terram.
Responsory Breve Sexta.eng:
℟.br. Thou shalt make them princes * over all the earth.
℣. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.
℟. All over the earth.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Thou shalt make them princes * over all the earth.

Responsory Breve Tertia.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Tertia.lat:
℟.br. In omnem terram * Exívit sonus eórum.
℣. Et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
℟. Exívit sonus eórum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. In omnem terram * Exívit sonus eórum.
Responsory Breve Tertia.eng:
℟.br. Their sound hath gone * forth into all the earth.
℣. And their words unto the ends of the world.
℟. Forth into all the earth.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Their sound hath gone * forth into all the earth.

Versum 1.label: Versicle
Versum 1.lat: ℣. In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum.
Versum 1.latR: ℟. Et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
Versum 1.eng: ℣. Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth:

Versum 2.label: Versicle
Versum 2.eng: ℣. They declared the works of God.
Versum 2.engR: ℟. And understood his doings.

Versum 3.label: Versicle
Versum 3.lat: ℣. Annuntiavérunt ópera Dei.
Versum 3.eng: ℣. They declared the works of God.
Versum 3.engR: ℟. And understood his doings.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hoc est præcéptum meum, * ut diligátis ínvicem, sicut diléxi vos.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This is my commandment * that you love one another, as I have loved you.

Ant Laudes.ant: Majórem caritátem * nemo habet, ut ánimam suam ponat quis pro amícis suis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Greater love than this no man hath, * that a man lay down his life for his friends.

Ant Laudes.ant: Vos amíci mei estis, * si fecéritis quæ præcípio vobis, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: You are my friends * if you do the things that I command you, said the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Beáti pacífici, * beáti mundo corde: quóniam ipsi Deum vidébunt.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed are the peacemakers * the clean of heart, they shall see God.

Ant Laudes.ant: In patiéntia vestra * possidébitis ánimas vestras.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In your patience * you shall possess your souls.

Ant Matutinum.ant: In omnem terram * exívit sonus eórum, et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Their sound * hath gone forth into all the earth: and their words unto the ends of the world.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Clamavérunt justi, * et Dóminus exaudívit eos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The just cried * and the Lord heard them.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Constítues eos * príncipes super omnem terram: mémores erunt nóminis tui, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou shalt make them princes * over all the earth. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Príncipes populórum * congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The princes of the people * are gathered together, with the God of Abraham.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dedísti hereditátem * timéntibus nomen tuum, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou hast given an inheritance * to them that fear thy name, O Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Annuntiavérunt * ópera Dei, et facta ejus intellexérunt.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They declared * the works of God, and understood his doings.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Exaltabúntur * córnua justi, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The horns of the just * shall be exalted. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Lux orta est * justo, allelúja, rectis corde lætítia, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Light is risen * to the just, alleluia, and joy to the right of heart. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Custodiébant * testimónia ejus, et præcépta ejus, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Hoc est præcéptum meum, * ut diligátis ínvicem, sicut diléxi vos.
Ant Vespera.antEng: This is my commandment * that you love one another, as I have loved you.

Ant Vespera.ant: Majórem caritátem * nemo habet, ut ánimam suam ponat quis pro amícis suis.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Greater love than this no man hath, * that a man lay down his life for his friends.

Ant Vespera.ant: Vos amíci mei estis, * si fecéritis quæ præcípio vobis, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: You are my friends * if you do the things that I command you, said the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: Beáti pacífici, * beáti mundo corde: quóniam ipsi Deum vidébunt.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Blessed are the peacemakers * the clean of heart, they shall see God.

Ant Vespera.ant: In patiéntia vestra * possidébitis ánimas vestras.
Ant Vespera.antEng: In your patience * you shall possess your souls.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Jurávit Dóminus, * et non pœnitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The Lord hath sworn * and will not repent: thou art a Priest for ever.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Cóllocet eum * Dóminus cum princípibus pópuli sui.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: That the Lord may set him * with the princes of his people.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Dirupísti, Dómine, * víncula mea: tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O Lord, thou hast loosed my bonds; * I will offer thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Eúntes ibant * et flebant, mitténtes sémina sua.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: They went forth weeping * sowing their seed.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Confortátus est * principátus eórum, et honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O God, thy friends are honourable; * their power is waxen right strong.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, intercéde pro nobis ad Dóminum.
Ant 1.eng: Blessed Mother and inviolate Maiden! * Glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!

Ant 1_.label: Antiphon
Ant 1_.lat: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, intercéde pro nobis ad Dóminum.
Ant 1_.eng: Blessed Mother and inviolate Maiden! * Glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!

Ant 1_Pasch.label: Antiphon
Ant 1_Pasch.lat: Regína cæli, * lætáre, allelúja; quia quem meruísti portáre, allelúja; resurréxit, sicut dixit, allelúja: ora pro nobis Deum, allelúja.
Ant 1_Pasch.eng: O Queen of heaven, * rejoice! alleluia: For He whom thou didst merit to bear, alleluia, Hath arisen as he said, alleluia. Pray for us to God, alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Jesu Christo: ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu.
Ant 2.eng: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ; pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.

Ant 2_.label: Antiphon
Ant 2_.lat: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Jesu Christo: ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu.
Ant 2_.eng: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ; pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: In platéis sicut cinnamómum et bálsamum aromatízans odórem dedi: quasi myrrha elécta, dedi suavitátem odóris.
Capitulum Nona.eng: As a plane tree by the water in the streets, I gave a sweet smell like cinnamon. and aromatical balm: I yielded a sweet odour like the best myrrh.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Et sic in Sion firmáta sum, et in civitáte sanctificáta simíliter requiévi, et in Jerúsalem potéstas mea. Et radicávi in pópulo honorificáto, et in parte Dei mei heréditas illíus, et in plenitúdine sanctórum deténtio mea.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And so was I established in Sion, and in the holy city likewise I rested, and my power was in Jerusalem. And I took root in an honourable people, and in the portion of my God his inheritance, and my abode is in the full assembly of saints.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: O gloriósa vírginum
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
O gloriósa vírginum,
Sublímis inter sídera,
Qui te creávit, párvulum
Lacténte nutris úbere.

Quod Heva tristis ábstulit,
Tu reddis almo gérmine:
Intrent ut astra flébiles,
Cæli reclúdis cárdines.

Tu Regis alti jánua
Et aula lucis fúlgida:
Vitam datam per Vírginem,
Gentes redémptæ, pláudite.

Jesu tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
O glorious lady! throned on high
Above the star-illumined sky;
Thereto ordained, thy bosom lent
To thy Creator nourishment.

Through thy sweet offspring we receive
The bliss once lost through hapless Eve;
And heaven to mortals open lies
Now thou art portal of the skies.

Thou art the door of heaven's high King,
Light's gateway fair and glistering;
Life through a Virgin is restored;
Ye ransomed nations, praise the Lord!

All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Quem terra, pontus, sídera
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Quem terra, pontus, sídera
Colunt, adórant, prædicant,
Trinam regéntem máchinam,
Claustrum Maríæ bájulat.

Cui luna, sol, et ómnia
Desérviunt per témpora,
Perfúsa cæli grátia,
Gestant puéllæ víscera.

Beáta Mater múnere,
Cujus supérnus ártifex
Mundum pugíllo cóntinens,
Ventris sub arca clausus est.

Beáta cæli núntio,
Fœcúnda sancto Spíritu,
Desiderátus géntibus,
Cujus per alvum fusus est.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
The God whom earth, and sea, and sky
Adore, and laud, and magnify,
Who o'er their threefold fabric reigns,
The Virgin's spotless womb contains.

The God, whose will by moon and sun
And all things in due course is done,
Is borne upon a maiden's breast,
By fullest heavenly grace possest.

How blest that mother, in whose shrine
The great artificer divine,
Whose hand contains the earth and sky,
Vouchsafed, as in his ark, to lie.

Blest, in the message Gabriel brought;
Blest, by the work the Spirit wrought;
From whom the great desire of earth
Took human flesh and human birth.

All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Vespera.label: Hymn
Hymnus Vespera.title: Ave maris stella
Hymnus Vespera.lat:
Ave maris stella,
Dei Mater alma,
Atque semper Virgo,
Felix cæli porta.

Sumens illud Ave
Gabriélis ore,
Funda nos in pace,
Mutans Hevæ nomen.

Solve vincla reis,
Profer lumen cæcis,
Mala nostra pelle,
Bona cuncta posce.

Monstra te esse matrem,
Sumat per te preces,
Qui pro nobis natus,
Tulit esse tuus.

Virgo singuláris,
Inter omnes mitis,
Nos culpis solútos
Mites fac et castos.

Vitam præsta puram,
Iter para tutum,
Ut vidéntes Jesum,
Semper collætémur.

Sit laus Deo Patri,
Summo Christo decus,
Spirítui Sancto,
Tribus honor unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Vespera.eng:
Ave, star of ocean,
Child divine who barest,
Mother, ever-Virgin,
Heaven's portal fairest.

Taking that sweet Ave
Erst by Gabriel spoken,
Eva's name reversing,
Be of peace the token.

Break the sinners' fetters,
Light to blind restoring,
All our ills dispelling,
Every boon imploring.

Show thyself a mother
In thy supplication;
He will hear who chose thee
At his incarnation.

Maid all maids excelling,
Passing meek and lowly,
Win for sinners pardon,
Make us chaste and holy.

As we onward journey
Aid our weak endeavour,
Till we gaze on Jesus
And rejoice forever.

Father, Son, and Spirit,
Three in One confessing,
Give we equal glory
Equal praise and blessing.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Ave María, grátia plena, * Dóminus tecum.
Invit.eng: Hail Mary, full of grace, * The Lord is with thee.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: In platéis sicut cinnamómum et bálsamum aromatízans odórem dedi: quasi myrrha elécta, dedi suavitátem odóris.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: O gloriósa vírginum
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
O gloriósa vírginum,
Sublímis inter sídera,
Qui te creávit, párvulum
Lacténte nutris úbere.

Quod Heva tristis ábstulit,
Tu reddis almo gérmine:
Intrent ut astra flébiles,
Cæli reclúdis cárdines.

Tu Regis alti jánua
Et aula lucis fúlgida:
Vitam datam per Vírginem,
Gentes redémptæ, pláudite.

Jesu tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
O glorious lady! throned on high
Above the star-illumined sky;
Thereto ordained, thy bosom lent
To thy Creator nourishment.

Through thy sweet offspring we receive
The bliss once lost through hapless Eve;
And heaven to mortals open lies
Now thou art portal of the skies.

Thou art the door of heaven's high King,
Light's gateway fair and glistering;
Life through a Virgin is restored;
Ye ransomed nations, praise the Lord!

All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Quem terra, pontus, sídera
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Quem terra, pontus, sídera
Colunt, adórant, prædicant,
Trinam regéntem máchinam,
Claustrum Maríæ bájulat.

Cui luna, sol, et ómnia
Desérviunt per témpora,
Perfúsa cæli grátia,
Gestant puéllæ víscera.

Beáta Mater múnere,
Cujus supérnus ártifex
Mundum pugíllo cóntinens,
Ventris sub arca clausus est.

Beáta cæli núntio,
Fœcúnda sancto Spíritu,
Desiderátus géntibus,
Cujus per alvum fusus est.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
The God whom earth, and sea, and sky
Adore, and laud, and magnify,
Who o'er their threefold fabric reigns,
The Virgin's spotless womb contains.

The God, whose will by moon and sun
And all things in due course is done,
Is borne upon a maiden's breast,
By fullest heavenly grace possest.

How blest that mother, in whose shrine
The great artificer divine,
Whose hand contains the earth and sky,
Vouchsafed, as in his ark, to lie.

Blest, in the message Gabriel brought;
Blest, by the work the Spirit wrought;
From whom the great desire of earth
Took human flesh and human birth.

All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Vespera.label: Hymn
Hymnus Vespera.title: Ave maris stella
Hymnus Vespera.lat:
Ave maris stella,
Dei Mater alma,
Atque semper Virgo,
Felix cæli porta.

Sumens illud Ave
Gabriélis ore,
Funda nos in pace,
Mutans Hevæ nomen.

Solve vincla reis,
Profer lumen cæcis,
Mala nostra pelle,
Bona cuncta posce.

Monstra te esse matrem,
Sumat per te preces,
Qui pro nobis natus,
Tulit esse tuus.

Virgo singuláris,
Inter omnes mitis,
Nos culpis solútos
Mites fac et castos.

Vitam præsta puram,
Iter para tutum,
Ut vidéntes Jesum,
Semper collætémur.

Sit laus Deo Patri,
Summo Christo decus,
Spirítui Sancto,
Tribus honor unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Vespera.eng:
Ave, star of ocean,
Child divine who barest,
Mother, ever-Virgin,
Heaven's portal fairest.

Taking that sweet Ave
Erst by Gabriel spoken,
Eva's name reversing,
Be of peace the token.

Break the sinners' fetters,
Light to blind restoring,
All our ills dispelling,
Every boon imploring.

Show thyself a mother
In thy supplication;
He will hear who chose thee
At his incarnation.

Maid all maids excelling,
Passing meek and lowly,
Win for sinners pardon,
Make us chaste and holy.

As we onward journey
Aid our weak endeavour,
Till we gaze on Jesus
And rejoice forever.

Father, Son, and Spirit,
Three in One confessing,
Give we equal glory
Equal praise and blessing.
Amen.

Equal praise and blessing.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Magnum * hereditátis mystérium: templum Dei factus est úterus nesciéntis virum: non est pollútus ex ea carnem assúmens; omnes gentes vénient dicéntes: Glória tibi, Dómine.
Ant 1.eng: Herein is a great mystery * of heirship; the womb of her that knew not a man is become the temple of God; in taking of her flesh, He was not defiled; all nations shall come and say: Glory be to thee, O Lord!

Ant 1_.label: Antiphon
Ant 1_.lat: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, intercéde pro nobis ad Dóminum.
Ant 1_.eng: Blessed Mother and inviolate Maiden! * Glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!

Ant 1_Pasch.label: Antiphon
Ant 1_Pasch.lat: Regína cæli, * lætáre, allelúja; quia quem meruísti portáre, allelúja; resurréxit, sicut dixit, allelúja: ora pro nobis Deum, allelúja.
Ant 1_Pasch.eng: O Queen of heaven, * rejoice! alleluia: For He whom thou didst merit to bear, alleluia, Hath arisen as he said, alleluia. Pray for us to God, alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Mirábile mystérium * declarátur hódie: innovántur natúræ, Deus homo factus est: id quod fuit permánsit, et quod non erat assúmpsit; non commixtiónem passus, neque divisiónem.
Ant 2.eng: This day is set forth a wonderful mystery, * a new thing hath been created in the earth: God is made man. That which He was, He remaineth; and that which He was not, He taketh; suffering therein neither confusion nor division.

Ant 2_.label: Antiphon
Ant 2_.lat: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Jesu Christo: ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu.
Ant 2_.eng: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ; pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.

Hymnus Laudes.lat:
O gloriósa vírginum,
Sublímis inter sídera,
Qui te creávit, párvulum
Lacténte nutris úbere.

Quod Heva tristis ábstulit,
Tu reddis almo gérmine:
Intrent ut astra flébiles,
Cæli reclúdis cárdines.

Tu Regis alti jánua
Et aula lucis fúlgida:
Vitam datam per Vírginem,
Gentes redémptæ, pláudite.

Jesu tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
O glorious lady! throned on high
Above the star-illumined sky;
Thereto ordained, thy bosom lent
To thy Creator nourishment.

Through thy sweet offspring we receive
The bliss once lost through hapless Eve;
And heaven to mortals open lies
Now thou art portal of the skies.

Thou art the door of heaven's high King,
Light's gateway fair and glistering;
Life through a Virgin is restored;
Ye ransomed nations, praise the Lord!

All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Colunt, adórant, prædicant,
Trinam regéntem máchinam,
Claustrum Maríæ bájulat.

Cui luna, sol, et ómnia
Desérviunt per témpora,
Perfúsa cæli grátia,
Gestant puéllæ víscera.

Beáta Mater múnere,
Cujus supérnus ártifex
Mundum pugíllo cóntinens,
Ventris sub arca clausus est.

Beáta cæli núntio,
Fœcúnda sancto Spíritu,
Desiderátus géntibus,
Cujus per alvum fusus est.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
The God whom earth, and sea, and sky
Adore, and laud, and magnify,
Who o'er their threefold fabric reigns,
The Virgin's spotless womb contains.

The God, whose will by moon and sun
And all things in due course is done,
Is borne upon a maiden's breast,
By fullest heavenly grace possest.

How blest that mother, in whose shrine
The great artificer divine,
Whose hand contains the earth and sky,
Vouchsafed, as in his ark, to lie.

Blest, in the message Gabriel brought;
Blest, by the work the Spirit wrought;
From whom the great desire of earth
Took human flesh and human birth.

All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Ant 1.lat: Magnum * hereditátis mystérium: templum Dei factus est úterus nesciéntis virum: non est pollútus ex ea carnem assúmens; omnes gentes vénient dicéntes: Glória tibi, Dómine.
Ant 1.eng: Herein is a great mystery * of heirship; the womb of her that knew not a man is become the temple of God; in taking of her flesh, He was not defiled; all nations shall come and say: Glory be to thee, O Lord!

Ant 1_.label: Antiphon
Ant 1_.lat: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, intercéde pro nobis ad Dóminum.
Ant 1_.eng: Blessed Mother and inviolate Maiden! * Glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!

Ant 1_Pasch.label: Antiphon
Ant 1_Pasch.lat: Regína cæli, * lætáre, allelúja; quia quem meruísti portáre, allelúja; resurréxit, sicut dixit, allelúja: ora pro nobis Deum, allelúja.
Ant 1_Pasch.eng: O Queen of heaven, * rejoice! alleluia: For He whom thou didst merit to bear, alleluia, Hath arisen as he said, alleluia. Pray for us to God, alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Mirábile mystérium * declarátur hódie: innovántur natúræ, Deus homo factus est: id quod fuit permánsit, et quod non erat assúmpsit; non commixtiónem passus, neque divisiónem.
Ant 2.eng: This day is set forth a wonderful mystery, * a new thing hath been created in the earth: God is made man. That which He was, He remaineth; and that which He was not, He taketh; suffering therein neither confusion nor division.

Ant 2_.label: Antiphon
Ant 2_.lat: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Jesu Christo: ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu.
Ant 2_.eng: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ; pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.

Capitulum Laudes.eng: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

Lacténte nutris úbere.

Intrent ut astra flébiles,
Cæli reclúdis cárdines.

Tu Regis alti jánua

Vitam datam per Vírginem,
Gentes redémptæ, pláudite.

Jesu tibi sit glória,

Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.

To thy Creator nourishment.

And heaven to mortals open lies
Now thou art portal of the skies.

Thou art the door of heaven's high King,
Light's gateway fair and glistering;
Life through a Virgin is restored;
Ye ransomed nations, praise the Lord!

All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Quem terra, pontus, sídera
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Quem terra, pontus, sídera
Colunt, adórant, prædicant,
Trinam regéntem máchinam,
Claustrum Maríæ bájulat.

Cui luna, sol, et ómnia
Desérviunt per témpora,
Perfúsa cæli grátia,
Gestant puéllæ víscera.

Beáta Mater múnere,
Cujus supérnus ártifex
Mundum pugíllo cóntinens,
Ventris sub arca clausus est.

Beáta cæli núntio,
Fœcúnda sancto Spíritu,
Desiderátus géntibus,
Cujus per alvum fusus est.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et almo Spíritu
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
The God whom earth, and sea, and sky
Adore, and laud, and magnify,
Who o'er their threefold fabric reigns,
The Virgin's spotless womb contains.

The God, whose will by moon and sun
And all things in due course is done,
Is borne upon a maiden's breast,
By fullest heavenly grace possest.

How blest that mother, in whose shrine
The great artificer divine,
Whose hand contains the earth and sky,
Vouchsafed, as in his ark, to lie.

Blest, in the message Gabriel brought;
Blest, by the work the Spirit wrought;
From whom the great desire of earth
Took human flesh and human birth.

All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Vespera.label: Hymn
Hymnus Vespera.title: Ave maris stella
Hymnus Vespera.lat:
Ave maris stella,
Dei Mater alma,
Atque semper Virgo,
Felix cæli porta.

Sumens illud Ave
Gabriélis ore,
Funda nos in pace,
Mutans Hevæ nomen.

Solve vincla reis,
Profer lumen cæcis,
Mala nostra pelle,
Bona cuncta posce.

Monstra te esse matrem,
Sumat per te preces,
Qui pro nobis natus,
Tulit esse tuus.

Virgo singuláris,
Inter omnes mitis,
Nos culpis solútos
Mites fac et castos.

Vitam præsta puram,
Iter para tutum,
Ut vidéntes Jesum,
Semper collætémur.

Sit laus Deo Patri,
Summo Christo decus,
Spirítui Sancto,
Tribus honor unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Vespera.eng:
Ave, star of ocean,
Child divine who barest,
Mother, ever-Virgin,
Heaven's portal fairest.

Taking that sweet Ave
Erst by Gabriel spoken,
Eva's name reversing,
Be of peace the token.

Break the sinners' fetters,
Light to blind restoring,
All our ills dispelling,
Every boon imploring.

Show thyself a mother
In thy supplication;
He will hear who chose thee
At his incarnation.

Maid all maids excelling,
Passing meek and lowly,
Win for sinners pardon,
Make us chaste and holy.

As we onward journey
Aid our weak endeavour,
Till we gaze on Jesus
And rejoice forever.

Father, Son, and Spirit,
Three in One confessing,
Give we equal glory
Equal praise and blessing.
Amen.

Ant Laudes.ant: Dum esset Rex * in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: While the King sitteth at his table, * my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof

Ant Laudes.ant: Læva ejus * sub cápite meo, et déxtera illíus amplexábitur me.
Ant Laudes.antEng: His left hand is under my head, * and his right hand doth embrace me.

Ant Laudes.ant: Nigra sum, * sed formósa, fíliæ Jerúsalem; ídeo diléxit me Rex, et introdúxit me in cubículum suum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: I am black but comely, * O ye daughters of Jerusalem; therefore hath the King loved me, and brought me into his chamber.

Ant Laudes.ant: Jam hiems tránsiit, * imber ábiit et recéssit: surge, amíca mea, et veni.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lo the winter is past, * the rain is over and gone. Rise up, my love, and come away.

Ant Laudes.ant: Speciósa * facta es et suávis in delíciis tuis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O Holy Mother of God, thou art become beautiful * and gentle in thy gladness.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedícta tu * in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed art thou among women, * and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sicut myrrha * elécta, odórem dedísti suavitátis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Mother of God * thou hast yielded a pleasant odor like the best myrrh.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ante torum * hujus Vírginis frequentáte nobis dúlcia cántica drámatis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing for us again and again before this maiden's bed * the tender idylls of the play.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Spécie tua * et pulchritúdine tua inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: In thy comeliness and thy beauty, * go forward, fare prosperously, and reign.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Adjuvábit eam * Deus vultu suo: Deus in médio ejus, non commovébitur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: God shall help * her with His countenance: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sicut lætántium * ómnium nostrum habitátio est in te, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Mother of God * all we who dwell in thee are in gladness.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Gaude, María Virgo: * cunctas hǽreses sola interemísti in univérso mundo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joy to thee, * O Virgin Mary, thou hast trampled down all the heresies in the whole world.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dignáre me * laudáre te, Virgo sacráta: da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Holy Virgin, my praise by thee accepted be; * give me strength against thine enemies.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Post partum, * Virgo, invioláta permansísti: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: After thy delivery thou still remainest a virgin; * undefiled Mother of God, pray for us.

Ant Vespera.ant: Jam hiems tránsiit, * imber ábiit et recéssit: surge, amíca mea, et veni.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Lo the winter is past, * the rain is over and gone. Rise up, my love, and come away.

Ant Vespera.ant: Speciósa * facta es et suávis in delíciis tuis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O Holy Mother of God, thou art become beautiful * and gentle in thy gladness.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, intercéde pro nobis ad Dóminum.
Ant 1.eng: Blessed Mother and inviolate Maiden! * Glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Jesu Christo: ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu.
Ant 2.eng: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ; pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, intercéde pro nobis ad Dóminum.
Ant 3.eng: Blessed Mother and inviolate Maiden! * Glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!

Ant Completorium.label: Antiphon
Ant Completorium.lat: Ant. Sub tuum præsídium * confúgimus, sancta Dei Génetrix: nostras deprecatiónes ne despícias in necessitátibus, sed a perículis cunctis libera nos semper, Virgo gloriósa et benedícta.
Ant Completorium.eng: Ant. We take refuge * under thy protection, O holy Mother of God! Despise not our supplications in our need, but deliver us always from all dangers, O Virgin, glorious and blessed!

Capitulum Completorium.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Completorium.lat:
Ego mater pulchræ dilectiónis, et timóris, et agnitiónis, et sanctæ spei.
_
V. Ora pro nobis sancta Dei Génetrix.
R. Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
Capitulum Completorium.eng:
I am mother of fair love, and fear, and knowledge, and holy hope.
_
V. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Vidérunt eam fíliæ Sion, et beatíssimam prædicavérunt et regínæ laudavérunt eam.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: The daughters of Zion saw her, and called her blessed; the queens also, and they praised her.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: In platéis sicut cinnamómum et bálsamum aromatízans odórem dedi: quasi myrrha elécta, dedi suavitátem odóris.
Capitulum Nona.eng: As a plane tree by the water in the streets, I gave a sweet smell like cinnamon. and aromatical balm: I yielded a sweet odour like the best myrrh.

Capitulum Prima.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Prima.lat: Quæ est ista, quæ progréditur quasi auróra consúrgens, pulchra ut luna, elécta ut sol, terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta?
Capitulum Prima.eng: Who is she that cometh forth like the rising dawn, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array?

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Et radicávi in pópulo honorificáto, et in parte Dei mei heréditas illíus, et in plenitúdine sanctórum deténtio mea.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And I took root in an honourable people, and in the portion of my God his inheritance, and my abode is in the full assembly of saints.

Capitulum Tertia.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Tertia.lat: Et sic in Sion firmáta sum, et in civitáte sanctificáta simíliter requiévi, et in Jerúsalem potéstas mea.
Capitulum Tertia.eng: And so was I established in Sion, and in the holy city likewise I rested, and my power was in Jerusalem.

Capitulum Vespera.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Vespera.lat: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
Capitulum Vespera.eng: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

Quem matris alvo géstiens,

Hymnus minor.label: Hymn
Hymnus minor.title: #Hymnus
Hymnus minor.lat:
#Hymnus
Meménto, rerum Cónditor,
Nostri quod olim córporis,
Sacráta ab alvo Vírginis
Nascéndo formam súmpseris.

María Mater grátiæ,
Dulcis Parens cleméntiæ,
Tu nos ab hoste prótege,
Et mortis hora súscipe.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus minor.eng:
#Hymnus
Remember, O creator Lord,
That in the Virgin's sacred womb
Thou wast conceived, and of her flesh
Didst our mortality assume.

Mother of grace, O Mary blest,
To thee, sweet fount of love, we fly;
Shield us through life, and take us hence
To thy dear bosom when we die.

O Jesu, born of Virgin bright,
Immortal glory be to thee;
Praise to the Father infinite,
And Holy Ghost eternally.
Amen.

Ant Laudes.ant: In odórem * unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: We run after thee, on the scent of thy perfumes * the virgins love thee heartily.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedícta * fília tu a Dómino: quia per te fructum vitæ communicávimus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed of the Lord art thou, O daughter, * for by thee we have been given to eat of the fruit of the tree of Life.

Ant Laudes.ant: Pulchra es, * et decóra, fília Jerúsalem: terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Fair and comely art thou, O daughter of Jerusalem, * terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Spíritus Sanctus * in te descéndet, María: ne tímeas, habébis in útero Fílium Dei, allelúja.
Ant 1.eng: The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, * O Mary; fear not, thou shalt bear in thy womb the Son of God. Alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Spíritus Sanctus * in te descéndet, María: ne tímeas, habébis in útero Fílium Dei, allelúja.
Ant 2.eng: The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, * O Mary; fear not, thou shalt bear in thy womb the Son of God. Alleluia.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Spíritus Sanctus * in te descéndet, María: ne tímeas, habébis in útero Fílium Dei, allelúja.
Ant 3.eng: The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, * O Mary; fear not, thou shalt bear in thy womb the Son of God. Alleluia.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Egrediétur virga de radíce Jesse, et flos de radíce ejus ascéndet. Et requiéscet super eum Spíritus Dómini.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: And there shall come forth a rod out of the root of Jesse, and a flower shall rise up out of his root. And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him.

Capitulum Vespera.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Vespera.lat: Egrediétur virga de radíce Jesse, et flos de radíce ejus ascéndet. Et requiéscet super eum Spíritus Dómini.
Capitulum Vespera.eng: And there shall come forth a rod out of the root of Jesse, and a flower shall rise up out of his root. And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Ave María, grátia plena, * Dóminus tecum.
Invit.eng: Hail Mary, full of grace, * The Lord is with thee.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui de beátæ Maríæ Vírginis útero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiánte, carnem suscípere voluísti: præsta supplícibus tuis; ut, qui vere eam Genetrícem Dei crédimus, ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur.
Oratio.eng: O God, who didst will that, at the announcement of an Angel, thy Word should take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary, grant to us thy suppliants, that we who believe her to be truly the Mother of God may be helped by her intercession with thee.

Ant Laudes.ant: Missus est * Gábriel Angelus ad Maríam Vírginem desponsátam Joseph. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Angel Gabriel was sent * to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph; and the virgin's name was Mary. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ave, María, * grátia plena; Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Hail, Mary, * full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ne tímeas, María, * invenísti grátiam apud Dóminum: ecce concípies et páries fílium. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Fear not, Mary, * thou hast found grace with the Lord; behold, thou shalt conceive, and bring forth a Son. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Dabit ei Dóminus * sedem David, patris ejus, et regnábit in ætérnum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Lord shall give unto Him * the throne of His father David, and of His kingdom there shall be no end. (Alleluia.)

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce ancílla Dómini: * fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold the handmaid of the Lord, * be it unto me according to thy word. (Alleluia.)

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedícta tu * in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed art thou among women, * and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sicut myrrha * elécta, odórem dedísti suavitátis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Mother of God * thou hast yielded a pleasant odor like the best myrrh.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ante torum * hujus Vírginis frequentáte nobis dúlcia cántica drámatis.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Sing for us again and again before this maiden's bed * the tender idylls of the play.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Spécie tua * et pulchritúdine tua inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: In thy comeliness and thy beauty, * go forward, fare prosperously, and reign.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Adjuvábit eam * Deus vultu suo: Deus in médio ejus, non commovébitur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: God shall help * her with His countenance: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sicut lætántium * ómnium nostrum habitátio est in te, sancta Dei Génetrix.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Holy Mother of God * all we who dwell in thee are in gladness.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Gaude, María Virgo: * cunctas hǽreses sola interemísti in univérso mundo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Joy to thee, * O Virgin Mary, thou hast trampled down all the heresies in the whole world.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dignáre me * laudáre te, Virgo sacráta: da mihi virtútem contra hostes tuos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Holy Virgin, my praise by thee accepted be; * give me strength against thine enemies.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ángelus Dómini * nuntiávit Maríæ, et concépit de Spíritu Sancto.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: After thy delivery thou still remainest a virgin; * undefiled Mother of God, pray for us.

Ant Vespera.ant: Missus est * Gábriel Angelus ad Maríam Vírginem desponsátam Joseph. (Allelúja.)
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Angel Gabriel was sent * to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph; and the virgin's name was Mary. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.antEng: Fear not, Mary, * thou hast found grace with the Lord; behold, thou shalt conceive, and bring forth a Son. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Dabit ei Dóminus * sedem David, patris ejus, et regnábit in ætérnum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord shall give unto Him * the throne of His father David, and of His kingdom there shall be no end. (Alleluia.)

Ant Vespera.ant: Ecce ancílla Dómini: * fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum. (Allelúja.)
Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold the handmaid of the Lord, * be it unto me according to thy word. (Alleluia.)

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Magnum * hereditátis mystérium: templum Dei factus est úterus nesciéntis virum: non est pollútus ex ea carnem assúmens; omnes gentes vénient dicéntes: Glória tibi, Dómine.
Ant 1.eng: Herein is a great mystery * of heirship; the womb of her that knew not a man is become the temple of God; in taking of her flesh, He was not defiled; all nations shall come and say: Glory be to thee, O Lord!

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Mirábile mystérium * declarátur hódie: innovántur natúræ, Deus homo factus est: id quod fuit permánsit, et quod non erat assúmpsit; non commixtiónem passus, neque divisiónem.
Ant 2.eng: This day is set forth a wonderful mystery, * a new thing hath been created in the earth: God is made man. That which He was, He remaineth; and that which He was not, He taketh; suffering therein neither confusion nor division.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Magnum * hereditátis mystérium: templum Dei factus est úterus nesciéntis virum: non est pollútus ex ea carnem assúmens; omnes gentes vénient dicéntes: Glória tibi, Dómine.
Ant 3.eng: Herein is a great mystery * of heirship; the womb of her that knew not a man is become the temple of God; in taking of her flesh, He was not defiled; all nations shall come and say: Glory be to thee, O Lord!

Ant Completorium.label: Antiphon
Ant Completorium.lat: Ant. Sub tuum præsídium * confúgimus, sancta Dei Génetrix: nostras deprecatiónes ne despícias in necessitátibus, sed a perículis cunctis libera nos semper, Virgo gloriósa et benedícta.
Ant Completorium.eng: Ant. We take refuge * under thy protection, O holy Mother of God! Despise not our supplications in our need, but deliver us always from all dangers, O Virgin, glorious and blessed!

Capitulum Completorium.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Completorium.lat:
Ego mater pulchræ dilectiónis, et timóris, et agnitiónis, et sanctæ spei.
_
V. Ora pro nobis sancta Dei Génetrix.
R. Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
Capitulum Completorium.eng:
I am mother of fair love, and fear, and knowledge, and holy hope.
_
V. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Vidérunt eam fíliæ Sion, et beatíssimam prædicavérunt et regínæ laudavérunt eam.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: The daughters of Zion saw her, and called her blessed; the queens also, and they praised her.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: In platéis sicut cinnamómum et bálsamum aromatízans odórem dedi: quasi myrrha elécta, dedi suavitátem odóris.
Capitulum Nona.eng: As a plane tree by the water in the streets, I gave a sweet smell like cinnamon. and aromatical balm: I yielded a sweet odour like the best myrrh.

Capitulum Prima.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Prima.lat: Quæ est ista, quæ progréditur quasi auróra consúrgens, pulchra ut luna, elécta ut sol, terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta?
Capitulum Prima.eng: Who is she that cometh forth like the rising dawn, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array?

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Et radicávi in pópulo honorificáto, et in parte Dei mei heréditas illíus, et in plenitúdine sanctórum deténtio mea.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And I took root in an honourable people, and in the portion of my God his inheritance, and my abode is in the full assembly of saints.

Capitulum Tertia.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Tertia.lat: Et sic in Sion firmáta sum, et in civitáte sanctificáta simíliter requiévi, et in Jerúsalem potéstas mea.
Capitulum Tertia.eng: And so was I established in Sion, and in the holy city likewise I rested, and my power was in Jerusalem.

Capitulum Vespera.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Vespera.lat: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
Capitulum Vespera.eng: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

Hymnus Completorium_C.label: Hymn
Hymnus Completorium_C.title: Eníxa est puérpera
Hymnus Completorium_C.lat:
Eníxa est puérpera,
Quem Gábriel prædíxerat,
Quem matris alvo géstiens,
Clausus Joánnes sénserat.
Hymnus Completorium_C.eng:
Eníxa est puérpera,
Quem Gábriel prædíxerat,
Quem matris alvo géstiens,
Clausus Joánnes sénserat.

Hymnus minor.label: Hymn
Hymnus minor.title: #Hymnus
Hymnus minor.lat:
#Hymnus
Meménto, rerum Cónditor,
Nostri quod olim córporis,
Sacráta ab alvo Vírginis
Nascéndo formam súmpseris.

María Mater grátiæ,
Dulcis Parens cleméntiæ,
Tu nos ab hoste prótege,
Et mortis hora súscipe.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus minor.eng:
#Hymnus
Remember, O creator Lord,
That in the Virgin's sacred womb
Thou wast conceived, and of her flesh
Didst our mortality assume.

Mother of grace, O Mary blest,
To thee, sweet fount of love, we fly;
Shield us through life, and take us hence
To thy dear bosom when we die.

O Jesu, born of Virgin bright,
Immortal glory be to thee;
Praise to the Father infinite,
And Holy Ghost eternally.
Amen.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui salútis ætérnæ, beátæ Maríæ virginitáte fecúnda, humáno géneri prǽmia præstitísti: tríbue, quǽsumus; ut ipsam pro nobis intercédere sentiámus, per quam merúimus auctórem vitæ suscípere, Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Fílium tuum:
Oratio.eng: O God, Who, by the fruitful virginity of the Blessed Mary, hast given unto mankind the rewards of everlasting life; grant, we beseech thee, that we may continually feel the might of her intercession, through whom we have worthily received the Author of our life, our Lord Jesus Christ, thy Son:

Oratio 1.label: Oratio
Oratio 1.lat: Concéde nos fámulos tuos, quǽsumus, Dómine Deus, perpétua mentis et córporis sanitáte gaudére: et, gloriósa beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis intercessióne, a præsénti liberári tristítia, et ætérna pérfrui lætítia.
Oratio 1.eng: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord God, unto all thy servants, that they may remain continually in the enjoyment of soundness both of mind and body, and by the glorious intercession of the Blessed Mary, always a Virgin, may be delivered from present sadness, and enter into the joy of thine eternal gladness.

Oratio 2.label: Oratio
Oratio 2.lat: Deus, qui de beátæ Maríæ Vírginis útero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiánte, carnem suscípere voluísti: præsta supplícibus tuis; ut, qui vere eam Genetrícem Dei crédimus, ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur.
Oratio 2.eng: O God, who didst will that, at the announcement of an Angel, thy Word should take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary, grant to us thy suppliants, that we who believe her to be truly the Mother of God may be helped by her intercession with thee.

Ant Laudes.ant: O admirábile commércium: * Creátor géneris humáni, animátum corpus sumens, de Vírgine nasci dignátus est; et procédens homo sine sémine, largítus est nobis suam Deitátem.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O wondrous interchange! * the Creator of mankind, taking upon him a living body, vouchsafed to be born of a pure Virgin: and by his Humanity, which was begotten in no earthly wise, hath made us partakers of his Divinity.

Ant Laudes.ant: Quando natus es * ineffabíliter ex Vírgine, tunc implétæ sunt Scriptúræ: sicut plúvia in vellus descendísti, ut salvum fáceres genus humánum: te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Laudes.antEng: When thou wast born * all ineffably of a Virgin, then were the Scriptures fulfilled; thou camest down like the dew upon the fleece of wool, to bring salvation unto all mankind; we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Rubum, quem víderat Móyses * incombústum, conservátam agnóvimus tuam laudábilem virginitátem: Dei Génetrix, intercéde pro nobis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In the bush which Moses saw * unconsumed, we recognize the preservation of thy glorious virginity: holy Mother of God, intercede for us.

Ant Laudes.ant: Germinávit radix Jesse, * orta est stella ex Jacob: Virgo péperit Salvatórem; te laudámus, Deus noster.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Root of Jesse hath budded, * the Star hath come out of Jacob, the Virgin hath borne the Saviour: we praise thee, O our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce María génuit * nobis Salvatórem, quem Joánnes videns, exclamávit, dicens: Ecce Agnus Dei, ecce qui tollit peccáta mundi, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lo, Mary hath brought forth * the Saviour of whom when John saw him, he did proclaim: Behold the Lamb of God that taketh away the sins of the world, alleluia.

Ant Vespera.antEng: When thou wast born * all ineffably of a Virgin, then were the Scriptures fulfilled; thou camest down like the dew upon the fleece of wool, to bring salvation unto all mankind; we praise thee, O our God.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, intercéde pro nobis ad Dóminum.
Ant 1.eng: Blessed Mother and inviolate Maiden! * Glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Jesu Christo: ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu.
Ant 2.eng: O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ; pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Beáta Mater * et intácta Virgo, gloriósa Regína mundi, intercéde pro nobis ad Dóminum.
Ant 3.eng: Blessed Mother and inviolate Maiden! * Glorious Queen of the world! Plead for us with the Lord!

Ant Completorium.label: Antiphon
Ant Completorium.lat: Ant. Sub tuum præsídium * confúgimus, sancta Dei Génetrix: nostras deprecatiónes ne despícias in necessitátibus, sed a perículis cunctis libera nos semper, Virgo gloriósa et benedícta.
Ant Completorium.eng: Ant. We take refuge * under thy protection, O holy Mother of God! Despise not our supplications in our need, but deliver us always from all dangers, O Virgin, glorious and blessed!

Capitulum Completorium.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Completorium.lat:
Ego mater pulchræ dilectiónis, et timóris, et agnitiónis, et sanctæ spei.
_
V. Ora pro nobis sancta Dei Génetrix.
R. Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
Capitulum Completorium.eng:
I am mother of fair love, and fear, and knowledge, and holy hope.
_
V. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
R. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Vidérunt eam fíliæ Sion, et beatíssimam prædicavérunt et regínæ laudavérunt eam.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: The daughters of Zion saw her, and called her blessed; the queens also, and they praised her.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: In platéis sicut cinnamómum et bálsamum aromatízans odórem dedi: quasi myrrha elécta, dedi suavitátem odóris.
Capitulum Nona.eng: As a plane tree by the water in the streets, I gave a sweet smell like cinnamon. and aromatical balm: I yielded a sweet odour like the best myrrh.

Capitulum Prima.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Prima.lat: Quæ est ista, quæ progréditur quasi auróra consúrgens, pulchra ut luna, elécta ut sol, terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta?
Capitulum Prima.eng: Who is she that cometh forth like the rising dawn, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array?

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Et radicávi in pópulo honorificáto, et in parte Dei mei heréditas illíus, et in plenitúdine sanctórum deténtio mea.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And I took root in an honourable people, and in the portion of my God his inheritance, and my abode is in the full assembly of saints.

Capitulum Tertia.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Tertia.lat: Et sic in Sion firmáta sum, et in civitáte sanctificáta simíliter requiévi, et in Jerúsalem potéstas mea.
Capitulum Tertia.eng: And so was I established in Sion, and in the holy city likewise I rested, and my power was in Jerusalem.

Capitulum Vespera.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Vespera.lat: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
Capitulum Vespera.eng: From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.

Hymnus Completorium_C.label: Hymn
Hymnus Completorium_C.title: Eníxa est puérpera
Hymnus Completorium_C.lat:
Eníxa est puérpera,
Quem Gábriel prædíxerat,
Quem matris alvo géstiens,
Clausus Joánnes sénserat.
Hymnus Completorium_C.eng:
Eníxa est puérpera,
Quem Gábriel prædíxerat,
Quem matris alvo géstiens,
Clausus Joánnes sénserat.

Hymnus minor.label: Hymn
Hymnus minor.title: #Hymnus
Hymnus minor.lat:
#Hymnus
Meménto, rerum Cónditor,
Nostri quod olim córporis,
Sacráta ab alvo Vírginis
Nascéndo formam súmpseris.

María Mater grátiæ,
Dulcis Parens cleméntiæ,
Tu nos ab hoste prótege,
Et mortis hora súscipe.

Jesu, tibi sit glória,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre et almo Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus minor.eng:
#Hymnus
Remember, O creator Lord,
That in the Virgin's sacred womb
Thou wast conceived, and of her flesh
Didst our mortality assume.

Mother of grace, O Mary blest,
To thee, sweet fount of love, we fly;
Shield us through life, and take us hence
To thy dear bosom when we die.

O Jesu, born of Virgin bright,
Immortal glory be to thee;
Praise to the Father infinite,
And Holy Ghost eternally.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Ave María, grátia plena, * Dóminus tecum.
Invit.eng: Hail Mary, full of grace, * The Lord is with thee.

Nocturn 1 Versum.eng: ℣. Grace is poured into thy lips.

Oratio 1.label: Oratio
Oratio 1.lat: Concéde nos fámulos tuos, quǽsumus, Dómine Deus, perpétua mentis et córporis sanitáte gaudére: et, gloriósa beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis intercessióne, a præsénti liberári tristítia, et ætérna pérfrui lætítia.
Oratio 1.eng: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord God, unto all thy servants, that they may remain continually in the enjoyment of soundness both of mind and body, and by the glorious intercession of the Blessed Mary, always a Virgin, may be delivered from present sadness, and enter into the joy of thine eternal gladness.

Oratio 2.label: Oratio
Oratio 2.lat: Deus, qui de beátæ Maríæ Vírginis útero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiánte, carnem suscípere voluísti: præsta supplícibus tuis; ut, qui vere eam Genetrícem Dei crédimus, ejus apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur.
Oratio 2.eng: O God, who didst will that, at the announcement of an Angel, thy Word should take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary, grant to us thy suppliants, that we who believe her to be truly the Mother of God may be helped by her intercession with thee.

Ant Laudes.ant: Assúmpta est María in cælum: * gaudent Angeli, laudántes benedícunt Dóminum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Mary hath been taken to heaven; * the Angels rejoice; they praise and bless the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: María Virgo assúmpta est * ad æthéreum thálamum, in quo Rex regum stelláto sedet sólio.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Virgin Mary hath been taken into the chamber on high, * where the King of kings sitteth on a throne amid the stars.

Ant Laudes.ant: In odórem * unguentórum tuórum cúrrimus: adolescéntulæ dilexérunt te nimis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: We run after thee, on the scent of thy perfumes * the virgins love thee heartily.

Ant Laudes.ant: Benedícta * fília tu a Dómino: quia per te fructum vitæ communicávimus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed of the Lord art thou, O daughter, * for by thee we have been given to eat of the fruit of the tree of Life.

Ant Laudes.ant: Pulchra es, * et decóra, fília Jerúsalem: terríbilis ut castrórum ácies ordináta.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Fair and comely art thou, O daughter of Jerusalem, * terrible as a fenced camp set in battle array.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Tradent enim vos * in concíliis, et in synagógis suis flagellábunt vos, et ante reges et prǽsides ducémini propter me in testimónium illis, et Géntibus.
Ant 1.eng: For they shall deliver you * up to councils: and in the synagogues you shall be beaten: and you shall stand before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony unto them.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Vos qui reliquístis * ómnia, et secúti estis me, céntuplum accipiétis, et vitam ætérnam possidébitis.
Ant 2.eng: You who left all * and follow me, you will receive hundredfolds, and you will have eternal life.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Estóte fortes * in bello, et pugnáte cum antíquo serpénte: et accipiétis regnum ætérnum, allelúja.
Ant 3.eng: Be valiant * in battle, fight the ancient serpent and accept the eternal kingdom. Alleluia.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Fratres: Jam non estis hóspites et ádvenæ: sed estis cives Sanctórum et doméstici Dei: superædificáti super fundaméntum Apostolórum, et Prophetárum, ipso summo angulári lápide Christo Jesu.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Brothers: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners; but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and the domestics of God, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Ibant Apóstoli gaudéntes a conspéctu concílii, quóniam digni hábiti sunt pro nómine Jesu contuméliam pati.
Capitulum Nona.eng: V. And the Apostles indeed went from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were accounted worthy to suffer reproach for the name of Jesus.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Per manus autem Apostolórum fiébant signa et prodígia multa in plebe.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Exsúltet orbis gáudiis
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Exsúltet orbis gáudiis:
Cælum resúltet láudibus:
Apostolórum glóriam
Tellus et astra cóncinunt.

Vos sæculórum júdices,
Et vera mundi lúmina:
Votis precámur córdium,
Audíte voces súpplicum.

Qui templa cæli cláuditis,
Serásque verbo sólvitis,
Nos a reátu nóxios
Solvi jubéte, quǽsumus.

Præcépta quorum prótinus
Languor salúsque séntiunt:
Sanáte mentes lánguidas:
Augéte nos virtútibus.

Ut, cum redíbit árbiter
In fine Christus sǽculi,
Nos sempitérni gáudii
Concédat esse cómpotes.

Patri, simúlque Fílio,
Tibíque Sancte Spíritus,
Sicut fuit, sit júgiter
Sæclum per omne glória.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Now let the earth with joy resound,
And heaven the chant re-echo round;
Nor heaven nor earth too high can raise
The great Apostles' glorious praise.

O ye who, throned in glory dread,
Shall judge the living and the dead,
Lights of the world forevermore!
To you the suppliant prayer we pour.

Ye close the sacred gates on high;
At your command apart they fly:
Oh! loose for us the guilty chain
We strive to break, and strive in vain.

Sickness and health your voice obey;
At your command they go or stay:
From sin's disease our souls restore;
In good confirm us more and more.

So when the world is at its end,
And Christ to judgement shall descend,
May we be called those joys to see
Prepared from all eternity.

Praise to the Father, with the Son,
And Holy Spirit, Three in One;
As ever was in ages past,
And so shall be while ages last.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Ætérna Christi múnera
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Ætérna Christi múnera,
Apostolórum glóriam,
Palmas et hymnos débitos
Lætis canámus méntibus.

Ecclesiárum Príncipes,
Belli triumpháles duces,
Cæléstis aulæ mílites,
Et vera mundi lúmina.

Devóta Sanctórum fides,
Invícta spes credéntium,
Perfécta Christi cáritas
Mundi tyránnum cónterit.

In his Patérna glória,
In his triúmphat Fílius,
In his volúntas Spíritus,
Cælum replétur gáudio.

Patri, simúlque Fílio,
Tibíque Sancte Spíritus,
Sicut fuit, sit júgiter
Sæclum per omne glória.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
Th' eternal gifts of Christ the King,
The Apostles' glory, let us sing;
And all with hearts of gladness raise
Due hymns of thankful love and praise.

For they the Church's princes are,
Triumphant leaders in the war,
The heavenly King's own warrior band,
True lights to lighten every land.

Theirs was the steadfast faith of saints,
The hope that never yields nor faints,
The love of Christ in perfect glow,
That lay the prince of this world low.

In them the Father's glory shone,
In them the Spirit's will was done,
The Son himself exults in them;
Joy fills the new Jerusalem.

Praise to the Father, with the Son,
And Holy Spirit, Three in One;
As ever was in ages past,
And so shall be while ages last.
Amen.

HymnusMMatutinumUS.label: Hymn
HymnusMMatutinumUS.title: Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus
HymnusMMatutinumUS.lat:
Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus,
Ut ipsórum consórtio
Jungas precántes sérvulos
In sempitérna sǽcula.
HymnusMMatutinumUS.eng:
Now to you, Redeemer, we ask:
That you might unite to the fellowship of those above
your servants at prayer here
Forever and ever more

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.eng: The Lord, the King of Apostles, * O come, let us adore.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Ibant Apóstoli gaudéntes a conspéctu concílii, quóniam digni hábiti sunt pro nómine Jesu contuméliam pati.
Lectio Prima.eng: V. And the Apostles indeed went from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were accounted worthy to suffer reproach for the name of Jesus.

Nocturn 2 Versum.lat: ℣. Constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram.
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. Thou shalt make them princes over all the earth.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Nimis honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. Thy friends, O Lord, are made exceedingly honourable.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. Their principality is exceedingly strengthened.

Responsory Breve Nona.lat:

℣. Nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.
℟. Amíci tui, Deus.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Nimis honoráti sunt * Amíci tui, Deus.
Responsory Breve Nona.eng:
℟.br. Thy friends, O God * are made exceedingly honourable.
℣. Their principality is exceedingly strengthened.
℟. O God, thy friends.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Thy friends, O God * are made exceedingly honourable.

Responsory Breve Sexta.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Sexta.lat:
℟.br. Constítues eos príncipes * Super omnem terram.
℣. Mémores erunt nóminis tui, Dómine.
℟. Super omnem terram.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Constítues eos príncipes * Super omnem terram.
Responsory Breve Sexta.eng:
℟.br. Thou shalt make them princes * over all the earth.
℣. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.
℟. All over the earth.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Thou shalt make them princes * over all the earth.

Responsory Breve Tertia.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Tertia.lat:
℟.br. In omnem terram * Exívit sonus eórum.
℣. Et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
℟. Exívit sonus eórum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. In omnem terram * Exívit sonus eórum.
Responsory Breve Tertia.eng:
℟.br. Their sound hath gone * forth into all the earth.
℣. And their words unto the ends of the world.
℟. Forth into all the earth.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Their sound hath gone * forth into all the earth.

Ant Laudes.ant: Hoc est præcéptum meum, * ut diligátis ínvicem, sicut diléxi vos.
Ant Laudes.antEng: This is my commandment * that you love one another, as I have loved you.

Ant Laudes.ant: Majórem caritátem * nemo habet, ut ánimam suam ponat quis pro amícis suis.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Greater love than this no man hath, * that a man lay down his life for his friends.

Ant Laudes.ant: Vos amíci mei estis, * si fecéritis quæ præcípio vobis, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: You are my friends * if you do the things that I command you, said the Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Beáti pacífici, * beáti mundo corde: quóniam ipsi Deum vidébunt.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Blessed are the peacemakers * the clean of heart, they shall see God.

Ant Laudes.ant: In patiéntia vestra * possidébitis ánimas vestras.
Ant Laudes.antEng: In your patience * you shall possess your souls.

Ant Matutinum.ant: In omnem terram * exívit sonus eórum, et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Their sound * hath gone forth into all the earth: and their words unto the ends of the world.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Clamavérunt justi, * et Dóminus exaudívit eos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The just cried * and the Lord heard them.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Constítues eos * príncipes super omnem terram: mémores erunt nóminis tui, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou shalt make them princes * over all the earth. They shall remember thy name, O Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Príncipes populórum * congregáti sunt cum Deo Ábraham.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The princes of the people * are gathered together, with the God of Abraham.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dedísti hereditátem * timéntibus nomen tuum, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou hast given an inheritance * to them that fear thy name, O Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Annuntiavérunt * ópera Dei, et facta ejus intellexérunt.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They declared * the works of God, and understood his doings.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Exaltabúntur * córnua justi, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The horns of the just * shall be exalted. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Lux orta est * justo, allelúja, rectis corde lætítia, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Light is risen * to the just, alleluia, and joy to the right of heart. Alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Custodiébant * testimónia ejus, et præcépta ejus, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.ant: Hoc est præcéptum meum, * ut diligátis ínvicem, sicut diléxi vos.
Ant Vespera.antEng: This is my commandment * that you love one another, as I have loved you.

Ant Vespera.ant: Majórem caritátem * nemo habet, ut ánimam suam ponat quis pro amícis suis.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Greater love than this no man hath, * that a man lay down his life for his friends.

Ant Vespera.ant: Vos amíci mei estis, * si fecéritis quæ præcípio vobis, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: You are my friends * if you do the things that I command you, said the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: Beáti pacífici, * beáti mundo corde: quóniam ipsi Deum vidébunt.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Blessed are the peacemakers * the clean of heart, they shall see God.

Ant Vespera.ant: In patiéntia vestra * possidébitis ánimas vestras.
Ant Vespera.antEng: In your patience * you shall possess your souls.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Jurávit Dóminus, * et non pœnitébit eum: Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The Lord hath sworn * and will not repent: thou art a Priest for ever.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Cóllocet eum * Dóminus cum princípibus pópuli sui.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: That the Lord may set him * with the princes of his people.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Dirupísti, Dómine, * víncula mea: tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O Lord, thou hast loosed my bonds; * I will offer thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Eúntes ibant * et flebant, mitténtes sémina sua.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: They went forth weeping * sowing their seed.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Confortátus est * principátus eórum, et honoráti sunt amíci tui, Deus.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: O God, thy friends are honourable; * their power is waxen right strong.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Lux perpétua * lucébit Sanctis tuis, Dómine, et ætérnitas témporum, allelúja.
Ant 1.eng: Eternal light will shine * over your saints, O Lord, and the eternity of times, alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Fíliæ Jerúsalem, * veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúja, allelúja.
Ant 2.eng: Daughters of Jerusalem, * come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Sancti et justi * in Dómino gaudéte, allelúja: vos elégit Deus in hereditátem sibi, allelúja.
Ant 3.eng: Saints and just * rejoice in the Lord, alleluia, the Lord has chosen you for his inheritance, alleluia.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Stabunt justi in magna constántia advérsus eos qui se angustiavérunt et qui abstulérunt labóres eórum.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Then shall the just stand with great constancy against those that have afflicted them, and taken away their labours.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Scimus quóniam diligéntibus Deum ómnia cooperántur in bonum, iis qui secúndum propósitum vocáti sunt sancti.
Capitulum Nona.eng: And we know that to them that love God, all things work together unto good, to such as, according to his purpose, are called to be saints.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum

Capitulum Sexta.eng: Behold how they are numbered among the children of God, and their lot is among the saints.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Paschále mundo gáudium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Paschále mundo gáudium
Sol núntiat formósior,
Cum luce fulgéntem nova
Jesum vident Apóstoli.

In carne Christi vúlnera
Micáre tamquam sídera
Mirántur, et quidquid vident
Testes fidéles prǽdicant.

Rex Christe clementíssime,
Tu corda nostra pósside:
Ut lingua grates débitas
Tuo repéndat nómini.

Ut sis perénne méntibus
Paschále Jesu gáudium;
A morte dira críminum
Vitæ renátos líbera.

Deo Patri sit glória,
Et Fílio, qui a mórtuis
Surréxit, ac Paráclito,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
With the fair sun of Easter morn
The world's excelling joy is born,
When, bright with new and greater grace,
The Apostles see the Saviour's face.

They in their Lord's fair flesh descry
The wounds that shine as stars on high,
And, wondering, faithful witness bear,
And all that they have seen declare.

O Christ, most loving King, we pray,
Possess our inmost hearts today,
While grateful lips with glad acclaim
Sing fervent praises to thy name.

Lord Jesu, that thou mayest be
Our Easter joy eternally,
Our souls from death of sin set free
That they, new born, may live to thee.

To God the Father, and the Son,
From death arisen, praise be done:
With God the Holy Ghost on high
Henceforth to all eternity.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Tristes erant Apóstoli
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Tristes erant Apóstoli
De Christi acérbo fúnere,
Quem morte crudelíssima
Servi necárant ímpii.

Sermóne verax Angelus
Muliéribus prædíxerat:
Mox ore Christus gáudium
Gregi feret fidélium.

Ad ánxios Apóstolos
Currunt statim dum núntiæ,
Illæ micántis óbvia
Christi tenent vestígia.

Galilǽæ ad alta móntium
Se cónferunt Apóstoli,
Jesúque, voti cómpotes,
Almo beántur lúmine.

Ut sis perénne méntibus
Paschále Jesu gáudium;
A morte dira críminum
Vitæ renátos líbera.

Deo Patri sit glória
Et Filio, qui a mórtuis
Surréxit, ac Paráclito
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
While Christ's disciples, grieving, sad,
Their master's painful death deplore,
Whom faithless servants' cruel hands,
Had bathed in his own crimson gore;

Quick from the happy realms above,
An angel comes on joyful wing,
And to the women tells the joy
That to his flock their Lord will bring.

As they with eager steps make haste,
Their joyous message to repeat,
Their master's glorious form they see,
And falling clasp his sacred feet.

Cheered by this tale, his faithful flock
The Galilean mount ascend,
And there with loving awe behold
Their heart's sole wish, their truest friend.

That thou mayst be our Paschal joy
Through happy, never-ending years,
thine own poor children, Jesu, free
From sin's sad death with all its fears.

To God the Father, and the Son,
Who rose from death, glad praise repeat;
Let equal praise be ever sung
To God the Holy Paraclete.
Amen.

HymnusMMatutinumUS.label: Hymn
HymnusMMatutinumUS.title: Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus
HymnusMMatutinumUS.lat:
Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus,
Ut ipsórum consórtio
Jungas precántes sérvulos
In sempitérna sǽcula.
HymnusMMatutinumUS.eng:
Now to you, Redeemer, we ask:
That you might unite to the fellowship of those above
your servants at prayer here
Forever and ever more
