Ant 2.lat: Vestri capílli cápitis * omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
Ant 2.eng: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: * fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Gaudent in cælis * ánimæ Sanctórum, qui Christi vestígia sunt secúti: et quia pro ejus amóre sánguinem suum fudérunt, ídeo cum Christo exsúltant sine fine.
Ant 3.eng: In heaven do rejoice the souls of the Saints * who have followed the steps of Christ; and because they shed their blood for the love of Christ, therefore shall they be made glad for ever with Christ.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Justórum ánimæ in manu Dei sunt, et non tanget illos torméntum mortis. Visi sunt óculis insipiéntium mori: illi autem sunt in pace.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: But the souls of the just are in the hand of God, and the torment of death shall not touch them. In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die, but they are in peace.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Fulgébunt justi, et tamquam scintíllæ in arundinéto discúrrent. Judicábunt natiónes, et dominabúntur pópulis: et regnábit Dóminus illórum in perpétuum.
Capitulum Nona.eng: The just shall shine, and shall run to and fro like sparks among the reeds. They shall judge nations, and rule over people, and their Lord shall reign for ever.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Réddidit Deus mercédem labórum sanctórum suórum, et dedúxit illos in via mirábili: et fuit illis in velaménto diéi, et in luce stellárum nocte.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And she rendered to the just the wages of their labours, and conducted them in a wonderful way: and she was to them for a covert by day, and for the light of stars by night.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Rex glorióse Mártyrum
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Rex glorióse Mártyrum,
Coróna confiténtium,
Qui respuéntes térrea
Perdúcis ad cæléstia:

Aurem benígnam prótinus
Inténde nostris vócibus:
Trophǽa sacra pángimus:
Ignósce quod delíquimus.

Tu vincis inter Mártyres
Parcísque Confessóribus:
Tu vince nostra crímina,
Largítor indulgéntiæ.

Deo Patri sit glória,
Ejúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
O glorious King of martyr hosts,
Thou crown that each confessor boasts,
Who leadest to celestial day
Those who have cast earth's joys away:

Thine ear in mercy, Saviour, lend,
While unto thee our prayers ascend;
And as we count their triumphs won,
Forgive the sins that we have done.

Martyrs in thee their triumphs gain,
From thee confessors grace obtain;
O'ercome in us the lust of sin,
That we thy pardoning love may win.

To thee who, dead, again dost live,
All glory, Lord, thy people give;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Christo profúsum sánguinem
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Christo profúsum sánguinem,
Et Mártyrum victórias,
Dignámque cælo láuream
Lætis sequámur vócibus.

Terróre victo sǽculi,
Pœnísque spretis córporis,
Mortis sacræ compéndio
Vitam beátam póssident.

Tradúntur igni Mártyres,
Et bestiárum déntibus;
Armáta sævit úngulis
Tortóris insáni manus.

Nudáta pendent víscera,
Sanguis sacrátus fúnditur;
Sed pérmanent immóbiles,
Vitæ perénnis grátia.

Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus,
Ut mártyrum consórtio
Jungas precántes sérvulos
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
The martyrs' triumphs let us sing,
Their blood poured forth for Christ the King,
And while due hymns of praise we pay,
Our thankful hearts cast grief away.

The world its terrors urged in vain;
They recked not of the body's pain;
One step, and holy death made sure
The life that ever shall endure.

To flames the martyr saints are hailed;
By teeth of savage beasts assailed;
Against them, armed with ruthless brand
And hooks of steel, their torturers stand.

The mangled frame is tortured sore,
The holy life-drops freshly pour;
They stand unmoved amidst the strife,
By grace of everlasting life.

Redeemer, hear us of thy love,
That, with the martyr host above,
Hereafter, of thine endless grace,
thy servants also may have place.
Amen.

Hymnus Vespera.label: Hymn
Hymnus Vespera.title: Sanctórum méritis ínclita gáudia
Hymnus Vespera.lat:
Sanctórum méritis ínclita gáudia
Pangámus, sócii, géstaque fórtia:
Gliscens fert ánimus prómere cántibus
Victórum genus óptimum.

Hi sunt, quos fátue mundus abhórruit;
Hunc fructu vácuum, flóribus áridum
Contempsére tui nóminis ásseclæ
Jesu, Rex bone cǽlitum.

Hi pro te fúrias, atque minas truces
Calcárunt hóminum, sǽvaque vérbera:
His cessit lácerans fórtiter úngula,
Nec carpsit penetrália.

Cædúntur gládiis more bidéntium:
Non murmur résonat, non quærimónia;
Sed corde impávido mens bene cónscia
Consérvat patiéntiam.

Quæ vox, quæ póterit lingua retéxere,
Quæ tu Martýribus múnera prǽparas?
Rubri nam flúido sánguine fúlgidis
Cingunt témpora láureis.

Te, summa o Déitas, únaque póscimus;
Ut culpas ábigas, nóxia súbtrahas,
Des pacem fámulis; ut tibi glóriam,
Annórum in sériem, canant.
Amen.
Hymnus Vespera.eng:
Sing, O sons of the Church sounding the martyrs' praise!
God's true soldiers applaud, who, in their weary days,
Won bright trophies of good, glad be the voice ye raise,
While these heroes of Christ ye sing!

They, while yet in the world were by the world abhorred;
Felt how fading the joys, fleeting the wealth it stored;
Spurned all pleasure for thee, and at thy call, O Lord,
Came forth strong in thy name, as King.

Lord, how bravely they bore fury and pain for thee!
Scourge, rod, sword, and the rack strongly endured; but free
Sang out, bold in thy love, longing on high to be;
Earth's might never their souls could bend.

While they, shedding their blood, victims for Jesus fell,
No sound out of their lips came of their throes to tell;
Bowed low, patient and meek, loving the Lord so well,
Turned they still to the Christ, their friend.

What joys, bright with the blood shed for thy love they share,
Those brave martyrs of thine crowned with thy laurels rare;
Man's tongue never can tell, never can half declare,
How pure now is their bliss above!

Yet we, Father on high, God of eternal might,
Lift weak voices in prayer asking for peace and light;
Cleanse thou out of our hearts every stain and blight,
So our songs may be songs of love.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.eng: The Lord, the King of Martyrs, * O come, let us worship.

Lectio Prima.eng: The just shall shine, and shall run to and fro like sparks among the reeds. They shall judge nations, and rule over people, and their Lord shall reign for ever.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. Let the righteous rejoice before God.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. Yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Justi autem in perpétuum vivent.
Nocturn 3 Versum.latR: ℟. Et apud Dóminum est merces eórum.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. The righteous live for evermore.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. Their reward also is with the Lord.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui nos concédis sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum N. et N. natalítia cólere: da nobis in ætérna beatitúdine de eórum societáte gaudére.
Oratio.eng: O God, who dost permit us to keep the birthday of thy holy Martyrs N. and N., grant that we may enjoy their fellowship in everlasting happiness.

Oratio 3.label: Oratio
Oratio 3.lat: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui beatórum Mártyrum tuórum N. et N. solémnia cólimus, eórum apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur.
Oratio 3.eng: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui beatórum Mártyrum tuórum N. et N. solémnia cólimus, eórum apud te intercessiónibus adjuvémur.

℣. Et delecténtur in lætítia.
℟. In conspéctu Dei.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Exsúltent justi * In conspéctu Dei.
Responsory Breve Sexta.eng:

Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Let the righteous rejoice * before God.

Responsory Breve Tertia.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Tertia.lat:
℟.br. Lætámini in Dómino, * Et exsultáte justi.
℣. Et gloriámini omnes recti corde.
℟. Et exsultáte justi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Lætámini in Dómino, * Et exsultáte justi.
Responsory Breve Tertia.eng:
℟.br. Be glad in the Lord, * and rejoice, ye righteous.
℣. And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
℟. And rejoice, ye righteous.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Be glad in the Lord, * and rejoice, ye righteous.

Ant Laudes.ant: Omnes Sancti, * quanta passi sunt torménta, ut secúri pervenírent ad palmam martýrii.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O how many torments have all the Saints suffered, * that they might attain safely unto the palm of martyrdom.

Ant Laudes.ant: Cum palma * ad regna pervenérunt Sancti, corónas decóris meruérunt de manu Dei.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Saints have attained unto the kingdom, * with palms in their hands; they have earned crowns of Majesty from the Lord's hand.

Ant Laudes.ant: Córpora Sanctórum * in pace sepúlta sunt: et vivent nómina eórum in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The bodies of the Saints are buried in peace, * and their name liveth for evermore.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mártyres Dómini * Dóminum benedícite in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Martyrs of the Lord, bless ye the Lord * for ever.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mártyrum chorus * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O ye Martyrs, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, praise Him with the dance, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Secus decúrsus aquárum * plantávit víneam justórum, et in lege Dómini fuit volúntas eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: By the rivers of water * hath the Lord planted the vineyard of the righteous, and in His Law do they meditate day and night.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tamquam aurum * in fornáce probávit eléctos Dóminus: et quasi holocáusta accépit eos in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: As gold in the furnace * hath the Lord tried His chosen ones, and received them for ever as a burnt-offering.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Si coram homínibus * torménta passi sunt, spes electórum est immortális in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Though the elect be punished * in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality for ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dabo Sanctis meis * locum nominátum in regno Patris mei, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I will give unto My Saints a place * in the kingdom of My Father, every one by his own name, saith the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sanctis, qui in terra sunt ejus, * mirificávit omnes voluntátes meas inter illos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: To the Saints that are in the earth * Thou hast made all my counsels admirable.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sancti qui sperant in Dómino, * habébunt fortitúdinem, assúment pennas ut áquilæ, volábunt, et non defícient.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Saints that wait upon the Lord * shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles, they shall fly and not faint.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Justi autem * in perpétuum vivent, et apud Dóminum est merces eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The righteous live * for evermore; their reward also is with the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tradidérunt * córpora sua in mortem, ne servírent idólis: ídeo coronáti póssident palmam.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They gave up their bodies unto death * rather than serve idols and therefore have they crowns on their heads and palms in their hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ecce merces * Sanctórum copiósa est apud Deum: ipsi vero mórtui sunt pro Christo, et vivent in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold, how great with God is the reward * of His Saints; yea, they who died for Christ's sake shall live for ever and ever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Omnes Sancti, * quanta passi sunt torménta, ut secúri pervenírent ad palmam martýrii.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O how many torments have all the Saints suffered, * that they might attain safely unto the palm of martyrdom.

Ant Vespera.ant: Cum palma * ad regna pervenérunt Sancti, corónas decóris meruérunt de manu Dei.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Saints have attained unto the kingdom, * with palms in their hands; they have earned crowns of Majesty from the Lord's hand.

Ant Vespera.ant: Córpora Sanctórum * in pace sepúlta sunt: et vivent nómina eórum in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The bodies of the Saints are buried in peace, * and their name liveth for evermore.

Ant Vespera.ant: Mártyres Dómini * Dóminum benedícite in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O all ye Martyrs of the Lord, bless ye the Lord * for ever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Mártyrum chorus * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O ye Martyrs, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, praise Him with the dance, alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Isti sunt Sancti, * qui pro testaménto Dei sua córpora tradidérunt, et in sánguine Agni lavérunt stolas suas.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: These men are holy, * for they have given up their bodies unto death for the sake of the covenant of their God, and have washed their robes in the Blood of the Lamb.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Sancti per fidem * vicérunt regna, operáti sunt justítiam, adépti sunt repromissiónes.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The Saints through faith subdued kingdoms, * wrought righteousness, obtained promises.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Sanctórum velut áquilæ * juvéntus renovábitur: florébunt sicut lílium in civitáte Dómini.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The youth of the Saints shall be renewed * like the eagle's they shall grow as the lily in the city of the Lord.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Abstérget Deus * omnem lácrimam ab óculis Sanctórum: et jam non erit ámplius neque luctus, neque clamor, sed nec ullus dolor: quóniam prióra transiérunt.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: God shall wipe away all tears from the eyes of His Saints * and there shall be no more sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain; for the former things are passed away.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: In cæléstibus regnis * Sanctórum habitátio est, et in ætérnum réquies eórum.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: In the heavenly kingdoms, * there is the dwelling of the Saints there shall be their rest for ever and ever.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Lux perpétua * lucébit Sanctis tuis, Dómine, et ætérnitas témporum, allelúja.
Ant 1.eng: Eternal light will shine * over your saints, O Lord, and the eternity of times, alleluia.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Fíliæ Jerúsalem, * veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúja, allelúja.
Ant 2.eng: Daughters of Jerusalem, * come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Sancti et justi * in Dómino gaudéte, allelúja: vos elégit Deus in hereditátem sibi, allelúja.
Ant 3.eng: Saints and just * rejoice in the Lord, alleluia, the Lord has chosen you for his inheritance, alleluia.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Stabunt justi in magna constántia advérsus eos qui se angustiavérunt et qui abstulérunt labóres eórum.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Then shall the just stand with great constancy against those that have afflicted them, and taken away their labours.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Scimus quóniam diligéntibus Deum ómnia cooperántur in bonum, iis qui secúndum propósitum vocáti sunt sancti.
Capitulum Nona.eng: And we know that to them that love God, all things work together unto good, to such as, according to his purpose, are called to be saints.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Ecce quómodo computáti sunt inter fílios Dei, et inter sanctos sors illórum est.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: Behold how they are numbered among the children of God, and their lot is among the saints.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sancti tui, * Dómine, florébunt sicut lílium, allelúja: et sicut odor bálsami erunt ante te, allelúja.

Ant Laudes.antEng: In the heavenly kingdom is the habitation of the saints, alleluia: and they rest in the eternity, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.antEng: Protected by a veil * your saints turn to you, O Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.antEng: Spirits and souls * of the just, sing hymns to our Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

Ant Laudes.antEng: The just shine * like the sun at the face of God, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Stabunt justi * in magna constántia advérsus eos, qui se angustiavérunt, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Then shall the just stand * with great constancy against those that have afflicted them, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ecce * quómodo computáti sunt inter fílios Dei, et inter sanctos sors illórum est, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold * how they are numbered among the children of God, and their lot is among the Saints, alleluia.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Istórum est enim * regnum cælórum qui contempsérunt vitam mundi, et pervenérunt ad prǽmia regni, et lavérunt stolas suas in sánguine Agni.
Ant 1.eng: For theirs is the Kingdom of heaven * who love not their lives in this world, and have attained unto the reward of the Kingdom, and have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Vestri capílli cápitis * omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
Ant 2.eng: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: * fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Gaudent in cælis * ánimæ Sanctórum, qui Christi vestígia sunt secúti: et quia pro ejus amóre sánguinem suum fudérunt, ídeo cum Christo exsúltant sine fine.
Ant 3.eng: In heaven do rejoice the souls of the Saints * who have followed the steps of Christ; and because they shed their blood for the love of Christ, therefore shall they be made glad for ever with Christ.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Justórum ánimæ in manu Dei sunt, et non tanget illos torméntum mortis. Visi sunt óculis insipiéntium mori: illi autem sunt in pace.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: But the souls of the just are in the hand of God, and the torment of death shall not touch them. In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die, but they are in peace.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Fulgébunt justi, et tamquam scintíllæ in arundinéto discúrrent. Judicábunt natiónes, et dominabúntur pópulis: et regnábit Dóminus illórum in perpétuum.
Capitulum Nona.eng: The just shall shine, and shall run to and fro like sparks among the reeds. They shall judge nations, and rule over people, and their Lord shall reign for ever.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Réddidit Deus mercédem labórum sanctórum suórum, et dedúxit illos in via mirábili: et fuit illis in velaménto diéi, et in luce stellárum nocte.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And she rendered to the just the wages of their labours, and conducted them in a wonderful way: and she was to them for a covert by day, and for the light of stars by night.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Rex glorióse Mártyrum
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Rex glorióse Mártyrum,
Coróna confiténtium,
Qui respuéntes térrea
Perdúcis ad cæléstia:

Aurem benígnam prótinus
Inténde nostris vócibus:
Trophǽa sacra pángimus:
Ignósce quod delíquimus.

Tu vincis inter Mártyres
Parcísque Confessóribus:
Tu vince nostra crímina,
Largítor indulgéntiæ.

Deo Patri sit glória,
Ejúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
O glorious King of martyr hosts,
Thou crown that each confessor boasts,
Who leadest to celestial day
Those who have cast earth's joys away:

Thine ear in mercy, Saviour, lend,
While unto thee our prayers ascend;
And as we count their triumphs won,
Forgive the sins that we have done.

Martyrs in thee their triumphs gain,
From thee confessors grace obtain;
O'ercome in us the lust of sin,
That we thy pardoning love may win.

To thee who, dead, again dost live,
All glory, Lord, thy people give;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Christo profúsum sánguinem
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Christo profúsum sánguinem,
Et Mártyrum victórias,
Dignámque cælo láuream
Lætis sequámur vócibus.

Terróre victo sǽculi,
Pœnísque spretis córporis,
Mortis sacræ compéndio
Vitam beátam póssident.

Tradúntur igni Mártyres,
Et bestiárum déntibus;
Armáta sævit úngulis
Tortóris insáni manus.

Nudáta pendent víscera,
Sanguis sacrátus fúnditur;
Sed pérmanent immóbiles,
Vitæ perénnis grátia.

Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus,
Ut mártyrum consórtio
Jungas precántes sérvulos
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
The martyrs' triumphs let us sing,
Their blood poured forth for Christ the King,
And while due hymns of praise we pay,
Our thankful hearts cast grief away.

The world its terrors urged in vain;
They recked not of the body's pain;
One step, and holy death made sure
The life that ever shall endure.

To flames the martyr saints are hailed;
By teeth of savage beasts assailed;
Against them, armed with ruthless brand
And hooks of steel, their torturers stand.

The mangled frame is tortured sore,
The holy life-drops freshly pour;
They stand unmoved amidst the strife,
By grace of everlasting life.

Redeemer, hear us of thy love,
That, with the martyr host above,
Hereafter, of thine endless grace,
thy servants also may have place.
Amen.

Hymnus Vespera.label: Hymn
Hymnus Vespera.title: Sanctórum méritis ínclita gáudia
Hymnus Vespera.lat:
Sanctórum méritis ínclita gáudia
Pangámus, sócii, géstaque fórtia:
Gliscens fert ánimus prómere cántibus
Victórum genus óptimum.

Hi sunt, quos fátue mundus abhórruit;
Hunc fructu vácuum, flóribus áridum
Contempsére tui nóminis ásseclæ
Jesu, Rex bone cǽlitum.

Hi pro te fúrias, atque minas truces
Calcárunt hóminum, sǽvaque vérbera:
His cessit lácerans fórtiter úngula,
Nec carpsit penetrália.

Cædúntur gládiis more bidéntium:
Non murmur résonat, non quærimónia;
Sed corde impávido mens bene cónscia
Consérvat patiéntiam.

Quæ vox, quæ póterit lingua retéxere,
Quæ tu Martýribus múnera prǽparas?
Rubri nam flúido sánguine fúlgidis
Cingunt témpora láureis.

Te, summa o Déitas, únaque póscimus;
Ut culpas ábigas, nóxia súbtrahas,
Des pacem fámulis; ut tibi glóriam,
Annórum in sériem, canant.
Amen.
Hymnus Vespera.eng:
Sing, O sons of the Church sounding the martyrs' praise!
God's true soldiers applaud, who, in their weary days,
Won bright trophies of good, glad be the voice ye raise,
While these heroes of Christ ye sing!

They, while yet in the world were by the world abhorred;
Felt how fading the joys, fleeting the wealth it stored;
Spurned all pleasure for thee, and at thy call, O Lord,
Came forth strong in thy name, as King.

Lord, how bravely they bore fury and pain for thee!
Scourge, rod, sword, and the rack strongly endured; but free
Sang out, bold in thy love, longing on high to be;
Earth's might never their souls could bend.

While they, shedding their blood, victims for Jesus fell,
No sound out of their lips came of their throes to tell;
Bowed low, patient and meek, loving the Lord so well,
Turned they still to the Christ, their friend.

What joys, bright with the blood shed for thy love they share,
Those brave martyrs of thine crowned with thy laurels rare;
Man's tongue never can tell, never can half declare,
How pure now is their bliss above!

Yet we, Father on high, God of eternal might,
Lift weak voices in prayer asking for peace and light;
Cleanse thou out of our hearts every stain and blight,
So our songs may be songs of love.
Amen.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et per beátos N. et N. Mártyres tuos atque Summos Pontífices perpétua protectióne custódi; quos totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastóres.
Oratio.eng: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed N. and N. thy Martyrs and Sovereign Pontiffs, whom thou didst constitute Shepherds of the whole Church.

Ant Laudes.ant: Omnes Sancti, * quanta passi sunt torménta, ut secúri pervenírent ad palmam martýrii.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O how many torments have all the Saints suffered, * that they might attain safely unto the palm of martyrdom.

Ant Laudes.ant: Cum palma * ad regna pervenérunt Sancti, corónas decóris meruérunt de manu Dei.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The Saints have attained unto the kingdom, * with palms in their hands; they have earned crowns of Majesty from the Lord's hand.

Ant Laudes.ant: Córpora Sanctórum * in pace sepúlta sunt: et vivent nómina eórum in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The bodies of the Saints are buried in peace, * and their name liveth for evermore.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mártyres Dómini * Dóminum benedícite in ætérnum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Martyrs of the Lord, bless ye the Lord * for ever.

Ant Laudes.ant: Mártyrum chorus * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O ye Martyrs, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, praise Him with the dance, alleluia.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Secus decúrsus aquárum * plantávit víneam justórum, et in lege Dómini fuit volúntas eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: By the rivers of water * hath the Lord planted the vineyard of the righteous, and in His Law do they meditate day and night.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tamquam aurum * in fornáce probávit eléctos Dóminus: et quasi holocáusta accépit eos in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: As gold in the furnace * hath the Lord tried His chosen ones, and received them for ever as a burnt-offering.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Si coram homínibus * torménta passi sunt, spes electórum est immortális in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Though the elect be punished * in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality for ever.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dabo Sanctis meis * locum nominátum in regno Patris mei, dicit Dóminus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I will give unto My Saints a place * in the kingdom of My Father, every one by his own name, saith the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sanctis, qui in terra sunt ejus, * mirificávit omnes voluntátes meas inter illos.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: To the Saints that are in the earth * Thou hast made all my counsels admirable.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sancti qui sperant in Dómino, * habébunt fortitúdinem, assúment pennas ut áquilæ, volábunt, et non defícient.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Saints that wait upon the Lord * shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles, they shall fly and not faint.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Justi autem * in perpétuum vivent, et apud Dóminum est merces eórum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The righteous live * for evermore; their reward also is with the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tradidérunt * córpora sua in mortem, ne servírent idólis: ídeo coronáti póssident palmam.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: They gave up their bodies unto death * rather than serve idols and therefore have they crowns on their heads and palms in their hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ecce merces * Sanctórum copiósa est apud Deum: ipsi vero mórtui sunt pro Christo, et vivent in ætérnum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold, how great with God is the reward * of His Saints; yea, they who died for Christ's sake shall live for ever and ever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Omnes Sancti, * quanta passi sunt torménta, ut secúri pervenírent ad palmam martýrii.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O how many torments have all the Saints suffered, * that they might attain safely unto the palm of martyrdom.

Ant Vespera.ant: Cum palma * ad regna pervenérunt Sancti, corónas decóris meruérunt de manu Dei.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Saints have attained unto the kingdom, * with palms in their hands; they have earned crowns of Majesty from the Lord's hand.

Ant Vespera.ant: Córpora Sanctórum * in pace sepúlta sunt: et vivent nómina eórum in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The bodies of the Saints are buried in peace, * and their name liveth for evermore.

Ant Vespera.ant: Mártyres Dómini * Dóminum benedícite in ætérnum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O all ye Martyrs of the Lord, bless ye the Lord * for ever.

Ant Vespera.ant: Mártyrum chorus * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O ye Martyrs, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, praise Him with the dance, alleluia.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Isti sunt Sancti, * qui pro testaménto Dei sua córpora tradidérunt, et in sánguine Agni lavérunt stolas suas.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: These men are holy, * for they have given up their bodies unto death for the sake of the covenant of their God, and have washed their robes in the Blood of the Lamb.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Sancti per fidem * vicérunt regna, operáti sunt justítiam, adépti sunt repromissiónes.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The Saints through faith subdued kingdoms, * wrought righteousness, obtained promises.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Sanctórum velut áquilæ * juvéntus renovábitur: florébunt sicut lílium in civitáte Dómini.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: The youth of the Saints shall be renewed * like the eagle's they shall grow as the lily in the city of the Lord.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: Abstérget Deus * omnem lácrimam ab óculis Sanctórum: et jam non erit ámplius neque luctus, neque clamor, sed nec ullus dolor: quóniam prióra transiérunt.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: God shall wipe away all tears from the eyes of His Saints * and there shall be no more sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain; for the former things are passed away.

Ant Vespera 3.ant: In cæléstibus regnis * Sanctórum habitátio est, et in ætérnum réquies eórum.
Ant Vespera 3.antEng: In the heavenly kingdoms, * there is the dwelling of the Saints there shall be their rest for ever and ever.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Fíliæ Jerúsalem, * veníte et vidéte Mártyres cum corónis, quibus coronávit eos Dóminus in die solemnitátis et lætítiæ, allelúja, allelúja.
Ant 2.eng: Daughters of Jerusalem, * come and see the crowned martyrs, the Lord crowned them in his solemnity and delight, alleluia, alleluia.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon

Ant 3.eng: Saints and just * rejoice in the Lord, alleluia, the Lord has chosen you for his inheritance, alleluia.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Rex glorióse Mártyrum
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Rex glorióse Mártyrum,
Coróna confiténtium,
Qui respuéntes térrea
Perdúcis ad cæléstia:

Aurem benígnam prótinus
Inténde nostris vócibus:
Trophǽa sacra pángimus:
Ignósce quod delíquimus.

Tu vincis inter Mártyres
Parcísque Confessóribus:
Tu vince nostra crímina,
Largítor indulgéntiæ.

Deo Patri sit glória,
Ejúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
O glorious King of martyr hosts,
Thou crown that each confessor boasts,
Who leadest to celestial day
Those who have cast earth's joys away:

Thine ear in mercy, Saviour, lend,
While unto thee our prayers ascend;
And as we count their triumphs won,
Forgive the sins that we have done.

Martyrs in thee their triumphs gain,
From thee confessors grace obtain;
O'ercome in us the lust of sin,
That we thy pardoning love may win.

To thee who, dead, again dost live,
All glory, Lord, thy people give;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Christo profúsum sánguinem
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Christo profúsum sánguinem,
Et Mártyrum victórias,
Dignámque cælo láuream
Lætis sequámur vócibus.

Terróre victo sǽculi,
Pœnísque spretis córporis,
Mortis sacræ compéndio
Vitam beátam póssident.

Tradúntur igni Mártyres,
Et bestiárum déntibus;
Armáta sævit úngulis
Tortóris insáni manus.

Nudáta pendent víscera,
Sanguis sacrátus fúnditur;
Sed pérmanent immóbiles,
Vitæ perénnis grátia.

Te nunc, Redémptor, quǽsumus,
Ut mártyrum consórtio
Jungas precántes sérvulos
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
The martyrs' triumphs let us sing,
Their blood poured forth for Christ the King,
And while due hymns of praise we pay,
Our thankful hearts cast grief away.

The world its terrors urged in vain;
They recked not of the body's pain;
One step, and holy death made sure
The life that ever shall endure.

To flames the martyr saints are hailed;
By teeth of savage beasts assailed;
Against them, armed with ruthless brand
And hooks of steel, their torturers stand.

The mangled frame is tortured sore,
The holy life-drops freshly pour;
They stand unmoved amidst the strife,
By grace of everlasting life.

Redeemer, hear us of thy love,
That, with the martyr host above,
Hereafter, of thine endless grace,
thy servants also may have place.
Amen.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Sacérdos et Póntifex, * et virtútum ópifex, pastor bone in pópulo, ora pro nobis Dóminum.
Ant 1.eng: O thou Priest and Bishop, * thou worker of mighty works, thou good shepherd over God’s people, pray for us unto the Lord.

Capitulum Laudes.lat: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Fungi sacerdótio, et habére laudem in nómine ipsíus, et offérre illi incénsum dignum in odórem suavitátis.
Capitulum Nona.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Non est invéntus símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi: ídeo jurejurándo fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: There was not found the like to him in glory, who kept the law of the most High, and was in covenant with him. Therefore by an oath he gave him glory in his posterity, that he should increase in his people.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Jesu Redémptor ómnium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Jesu Redémptor ómnium,
Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
In hac die cleméntius
Indúlgeas precántibus.

Tui sacri qua nóminis
Conféssor almus cláruit:
Hujus celébrat ánnua
Devóta plebs solémnia.

Qui rite mundi gáudia
Hujus cadúca réspuens,
Æternitátis prǽmio
Potítur inter Ángelos.

Hujus benígnus ánnue
Nobis sequi vestígia:
Hujus precátu, sérvulis
Dimítte noxam críminis.

Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
Tibi, Patríque glória,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;
thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:
Accept with gentlest love today
The prayers and praises that we pay.

The meek confessor of thy name
Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,
Thy faithful people celebrate.

The world and all its boasted good,
As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,
In endless joy forever stands.

Grant then that we, most gracious God,
May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free
From stain of all iniquity.

To thee, O Christ, our loving King,
All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Quem pie laudant pópuli per orbem,
Hac die lætus méruit beátas
Scándere sedes.

Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
Sóbriam duxit sine labe vitam,
Donec humános animávit auræ
Spíritus artus.

Cujus ob præstans méritum, frequénter,
Ægra quæ passim jacuére membra,
Víribus morbi dómitis, salúti
Restituúntur.

Noster hinc illi chorus obsequéntem
Cóncinit laudem celebrésque palmas,
Ut piis ejus précibus juvémur
Omne per ævum.

Sit salus illi, decus atque virtus,
Qui, super cæli sólio corúscans,
Tótius mundi sériem gubérnat,
Trinus et unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
This the confessor of the Lord, whose triumph
Now all the faithful celebrate, with gladness
Erst on this feast-day merited to enter
Into his glory.

Saintly and prudent, modest in behaviour,
Peaceful and sober, chaste was he, and lowly.
While that life’s vigour, coursing through his members,
Quickened his being.

Sick ones of old time, to his tomb resorting,
Sorely by ailments manifold afflicted,
Oft-times have welcomed health and strength returning,
At his petition.

Whence we in chorus gladly do him honour,
Chanting his praises with devout affection,
That in his merits we may have a portion,
Now and forever.

His be the glory, power and salvation,
Who over all things reigneth in the highest,
Earth’s mighty fabric ruling and directing,
Onely and Trinal.
Amen.

Lectio Prima.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. The Lord hath chosen him for a Priest unto Himself.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.

Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. After the order of Melchisedek.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Exáudi, quǽsumus, Dómine, preces nostras, quas in beáti N. Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis solemnitáte deférimus: et, qui tibi digne méruit famulári, ejus intercedéntibus méritis, ab ómnibus nos absólve peccátis.
Oratio.eng: Hear, O Lord, we beseech thee, the prayers which we offer thee on this the solemn feast-day of thy blessed Confessor and bishop N., and, for the sake of him who so nobly served thee, forgive us our trespasses.

Ant Laudes.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ideo jurejurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus vir, * qui in lege Dómini meditátur: volúntas ejus pérmanet die ac nocte, et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, semper prosperabúntur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed is the man * that doth meditate in the law of the Lord; his delight is therein day and night, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus iste Sanctus, * qui confísus est in Dómino, prædicávit præcéptum Dómini, constitútus est in monte sancto ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed and holy is he * that putteth his trust in the Lord, that declareth the decree of the Lord, and is set upon His holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es glória mea, * tu es suscéptor meus, Dómine; tu exáltans caput meum, et exaudísti me de monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou, O Lord, art my glory, * Thou art a shield for me; Thou art the Lifter-up of mine head, and Thou hast heard me out of thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invocántem * exaudívit Dóminus Sanctum suum; Dóminus exaudívit eum, et constítuit eum in pace.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Jesu Redémptor ómnium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Jesu Redémptor ómnium,
Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
In hac die cleméntius
Indúlgeas precántibus.

Tui sacri qua nóminis
Conféssor almus cláruit:
Hujus celébrat ánnua
Devóta plebs solémnia.

Qui rite mundi gáudia
Hujus cadúca réspuens,
Æternitátis prǽmio
Potítur inter Ángelos.

Hujus benígnus ánnue
Nobis sequi vestígia:
Hujus precátu, sérvulis
Dimítte noxam críminis.

Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
Tibi, Patríque glória,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;
thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:
Accept with gentlest love today
The prayers and praises that we pay.

The meek confessor of thy name
Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,
Thy faithful people celebrate.

The world and all its boasted good,
As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,
In endless joy forever stands.

Grant then that we, most gracious God,
May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free
From stain of all iniquity.

To thee, O Christ, our loving King,
All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Quem pie laudant pópuli per orbem,
Hac die lætus méruit beátas
Scándere sedes.

Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
Sóbriam duxit sine labe vitam,
Donec humános animávit auræ
Spíritus artus.

Cujus ob præstans méritum, frequénter,
Ægra quæ passim jacuére membra,
Víribus morbi dómitis, salúti
Restituúntur.

Noster hinc illi chorus obsequéntem
Cóncinit laudem celebrésque palmas,
Ut piis ejus précibus juvémur
Omne per ævum.

Sit salus illi, decus atque virtus,
Qui, super cæli sólio corúscans,
Tótius mundi sériem gubérnat,
Trinus et unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
This the confessor of the Lord, whose triumph
Now all the faithful celebrate, with gladness
Erst on this feast-day merited to enter
Into his glory.

Saintly and prudent, modest in behaviour,
Peaceful and sober, chaste was he, and lowly.
While that life’s vigour, coursing through his members,
Quickened his being.

Sick ones of old time, to his tomb resorting,
Sorely by ailments manifold afflicted,
Oft-times have welcomed health and strength returning,
At his petition.

Whence we in chorus gladly do him honour,
Chanting his praises with devout affection,
That in his merits we may have a portion,
Now and forever.

His be the glory, power and salvation,
Who over all things reigneth in the highest,
Earth’s mighty fabric ruling and directing,
Onely and Trinal.
Amen.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Jesu Redémptor ómnium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Jesu Redémptor ómnium,
Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
In hac die cleméntius
Indúlgeas precántibus.

Tui sacri qua nóminis
Conféssor almus cláruit:
Hujus celébrat ánnua
Devóta plebs solémnia.

Qui rite mundi gáudia
Hujus cadúca réspuens,
Æternitátis prǽmio
Potítur inter Ángelos.

Hujus benígnus ánnue
Nobis sequi vestígia:
Hujus precátu, sérvulis
Dimítte noxam críminis.

Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
Tibi, Patríque glória,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;
thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:
Accept with gentlest love today
The prayers and praises that we pay.

The meek confessor of thy name
Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,
Thy faithful people celebrate.

The world and all its boasted good,
As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,
In endless joy forever stands.

Grant then that we, most gracious God,
May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free
From stain of all iniquity.

To thee, O Christ, our loving King,
All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Quem pie laudant pópuli per orbem,
Hac die lætus méruit beátas
Scándere sedes.

Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
Sóbriam duxit sine labe vitam,
Donec humános animávit auræ
Spíritus artus.

Cujus ob præstans méritum, frequénter,
Ægra quæ passim jacuére membra,
Víribus morbi dómitis, salúti
Restituúntur.

Noster hinc illi chorus obsequéntem
Cóncinit laudem celebrésque palmas,
Ut piis ejus précibus juvémur
Omne per ævum.

Sit salus illi, decus atque virtus,
Qui, super cæli sólio corúscans,
Tótius mundi sériem gubérnat,
Trinus et unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
This the confessor of the Lord, whose triumph
Now all the faithful celebrate, with gladness
Erst on this feast-day merited to enter
Into his glory.

Saintly and prudent, modest in behaviour,
Peaceful and sober, chaste was he, and lowly.
While that life’s vigour, coursing through his members,
Quickened his being.

Sick ones of old time, to his tomb resorting,
Sorely by ailments manifold afflicted,
Oft-times have welcomed health and strength returning,
At his petition.

Whence we in chorus gladly do him honour,
Chanting his praises with devout affection,
That in his merits we may have a portion,
Now and forever.

His be the glory, power and salvation,
Who over all things reigneth in the highest,
Earth’s mighty fabric ruling and directing,
Onely and Trinal.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.eng: The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Fungi sacerdótio, et habére laudem in nómine ipsíus, et offérre illi incénsum dignum in odórem suavitátis.
Lectio Prima.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. The Lord hath chosen him for a Priest unto Himself.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. Thou art a Priest for ever.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. After the order of Melchisedek.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum N. minístrum tribuísti: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, quem Doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris, intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis.
Oratio.eng: O God, who didst give blessed N. to be thy people’s minister in eternal salvation; grant, we pray, that we who have him for teacher of life here on earth, may also deserve now that he is in heaven, to have him for an advocate.

Responsory Breve Nona.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Nona.lat:
℟.br. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.
℣. Secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
℟. In ætérnum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.
Responsory Breve Nona.eng:
℟.br. Thou art a Priest * for ever.
℣. After the order of Melchisedek.
℟. For ever.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Thou art a Priest * for ever.

Responsory Breve Sexta.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Sexta.lat:
℟.br. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.
℣. Ad sacrificándum ei hóstiam laudis.
℟. Sacerdótem sibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.
Responsory Breve Sexta.eng:
℟.br. The Lord hath chosen him * for a Priest unto Himself.
℣. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.
℟. For a Priest unto Himself.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. The Lord hath chosen him * for a Priest unto Himself.

Responsory Breve Tertia.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Tertia.lat:
℟.br. Amávit eum Dóminus, * Et ornávit eum.
℣. Stolam glóriæ índuit eum.
℟. Et ornávit eum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Amávit eum Dóminus, * Et ornávit eum.

℣. He clothed him with a robe of glory.
℟. And beautified him.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. The Lord loved him, * and beautified him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce sacérdos magnus, * qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

Ant Laudes.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ideo jurejurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus vir, * qui in lege Dómini meditátur: volúntas ejus pérmanet die ac nocte, et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, semper prosperabúntur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed is the man * that doth meditate in the law of the Lord; his delight is therein day and night, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus iste Sanctus, * qui confísus est in Dómino, prædicávit præcéptum Dómini, constitútus est in monte sancto ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed and holy is he * that putteth his trust in the Lord, that declareth the decree of the Lord, and is set upon His holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es glória mea, * tu es suscéptor meus, Dómine; tu exáltans caput meum, et exaudísti me de monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou, O Lord, art my glory, * Thou art a shield for me; Thou art the Lifter-up of mine head, and Thou hast heard me out of thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invocántem * exaudívit Dóminus Sanctum suum; Dóminus exaudívit eum, et constítuit eum in pace.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When His holy one called, * the Lord heard him, yea, the Lord heard him, and gave him peace.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Læténtur omnes * qui sperant in te, Dómine; quóniam tu benedixísti justo, scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ coronásti eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice, O Lord, for Thou hast blessed the righteous; * Thou hast compassed him with thy favour as with a shield.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra! quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctum tuum, et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, our Ruler, * how excellent is thy Name in all the earth, Who hast crowned thine holy one with glory and honour, and made him to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * iste Sanctus habitábit in tabernáculo tuo, operátus est justítiam, requiéscet in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, this thy Saint * shall dwell in thy tabernacle, and this that hath worked righteousness shall abide upon thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vitam pétiit * a te, et tribuísti ei, Dómine: glóriam et magnum decórem imposuísti super eum; posuísti in cápite ejus corónam de lápide pretióso.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He asked life of thee, * and Thou, O Lord, gavest it; honour and great majesty hast Thou laid upon him; Thou hast set a crown of precious stones upon his head.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hic accípiet * benedictiónem a Dómino, et misericórdiam a Deo salutári suo: quia hæc est generátio quæréntium Dóminum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He shall receive * a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from the God of his salvation, for this is the generation of them that seek the Lord.

Ant Vespera.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Sacérdos et Póntifex, * et virtútum ópifex, pastor bone in pópulo, ora pro nobis Dóminum.
Ant 1.eng: O thou Priest and Bishop, * thou worker of mighty works, thou good shepherd over God’s people, pray for us unto the Lord.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.
Ant 2.eng: Well done, thou good and faithful servant * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Dum esset Summus Póntifex, * terréna non métuit, sed ad cæléstia regna gloriósus migrávit.
Ant 3.eng: While he was supreme Pontiff, * he feared not earthly powers, but gloriously went his way to the heavenly kingdom.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.eng: The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Fungi sacerdótio, et habére laudem in nómine ipsíus, et offérre illi incénsum dignum in odórem suavitátis.
Lectio Prima.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. The Lord hath chosen him for a Priest unto Himself.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. Thou art a Priest for ever.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. After the order of Melchisedek.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum N. Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
Oratio.eng: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed N. thy Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.

Responsory Breve Nona.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Nona.lat:
℟.br. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.
℣. Secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
℟. In ætérnum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.
Responsory Breve Nona.eng:
℟.br. Thou art a Priest * for ever.
℣. After the order of Melchisedek.
℟. For ever.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Thou art a Priest * for ever.

Responsory Breve Sexta.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Sexta.lat:
℟.br. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.
℣. Ad sacrificándum ei hóstiam laudis.
℟. Sacerdótem sibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.
Responsory Breve Sexta.eng:
℟.br. The Lord hath chosen him * for a Priest unto Himself.
℣. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.
℟. For a Priest unto Himself.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. The Lord hath chosen him * for a Priest unto Himself.

Responsory Breve Tertia.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Tertia.lat:
℟.br. Amávit eum Dóminus, * Et ornávit eum.
℣. Stolam glóriæ índuit eum.
℟. Et ornávit eum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Amávit eum Dóminus, * Et ornávit eum.

℣. He clothed him with a robe of glory.
℟. And beautified him.

℟. The Lord loved him, * and beautified him.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce sacérdos magnus, * qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

Ant Laudes.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ideo jurejurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus vir, * qui in lege Dómini meditátur: volúntas ejus pérmanet die ac nocte, et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, semper prosperabúntur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed is the man * that doth meditate in the law of the Lord; his delight is therein day and night, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus iste Sanctus, * qui confísus est in Dómino, prædicávit præcéptum Dómini, constitútus est in monte sancto ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed and holy is he * that putteth his trust in the Lord, that declareth the decree of the Lord, and is set upon His holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es glória mea, * tu es suscéptor meus, Dómine; tu exáltans caput meum, et exaudísti me de monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou, O Lord, art my glory, * Thou art a shield for me; Thou art the Lifter-up of mine head, and Thou hast heard me out of thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invocántem * exaudívit Dóminus Sanctum suum; Dóminus exaudívit eum, et constítuit eum in pace.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When His holy one called, * the Lord heard him, yea, the Lord heard him, and gave him peace.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Læténtur omnes * qui sperant in te, Dómine; quóniam tu benedixísti justo, scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ coronásti eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice, O Lord, for Thou hast blessed the righteous; * Thou hast compassed him with thy favour as with a shield.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra! quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctum tuum, et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, our Ruler, * how excellent is thy Name in all the earth, Who hast crowned thine holy one with glory and honour, and made him to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * iste Sanctus habitábit in tabernáculo tuo, operátus est justítiam, requiéscet in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, this thy Saint * shall dwell in thy tabernacle, and this that hath worked righteousness shall abide upon thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vitam pétiit * a te, et tribuísti ei, Dómine: glóriam et magnum decórem imposuísti super eum; posuísti in cápite ejus corónam de lápide pretióso.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He asked life of thee, * and Thou, O Lord, gavest it; honour and great majesty hast Thou laid upon him; Thou hast set a crown of precious stones upon his head.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hic accípiet * benedictiónem a Dómino, et misericórdiam a Deo salutári suo: quia hæc est generátio quæréntium Dóminum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He shall receive * a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from the God of his salvation, for this is the generation of them that seek the Lord.

Ant Vespera.antEng: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

Ant Vespera.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.

Ant Vespera.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte N., divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei.
Ant 1.eng: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, N., blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.
Ant 2.eng: Well done, thou good and faithful servant * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: O Doctor óptime, * Ecclésiæ sanctæ lumen, beáte N., divínæ legis amátor, deprecáre pro nobis Fílium Dei.
Ant 3.eng: O right excellent Teacher * Light of the Holy Church, N., blessed lover of the Divine Law, pray for us to the Son of God.

Ant 3 summi Pontificis.label: Antiphon
Ant 3 summi Pontificis.lat: Dum esset Summus Póntifex, * terréna non métuit, sed ad cæléstia regna gloriósus migrávit.
Ant 3 summi Pontificis.eng: While he was supreme Pontiff, * he feared not earthly powers, but gloriously went his way to the heavenly kingdom.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Fungi sacerdótio, et habére laudem in nómine ipsíus, et offérre illi incénsum dignum in odórem suavitátis.
Capitulum Nona.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Non est invéntus símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi: ídeo jurejurándo fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: There was not found the like to him in glory, who kept the law of the most High, and was in covenant with him. Therefore by an oath he gave him glory in his posterity, that he should increase in his people.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Jesu Redémptor ómnium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Jesu Redémptor ómnium,
Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
In hac die cleméntius
Indúlgeas precántibus.

Tui sacri qua nóminis
Conféssor almus cláruit:
Hujus celébrat ánnua
Devóta plebs solémnia.

Qui rite mundi gáudia
Hujus cadúca réspuens,
Æternitátis prǽmio
Potítur inter Ángelos.

Hujus benígnus ánnue
Nobis sequi vestígia:
Hujus precátu, sérvulis
Dimítte noxam críminis.

Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
Tibi, Patríque glória,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;
thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:
Accept with gentlest love today
The prayers and praises that we pay.

The meek confessor of thy name
Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,
Thy faithful people celebrate.

The world and all its boasted good,
As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,
In endless joy forever stands.

Grant then that we, most gracious God,
May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free
From stain of all iniquity.

To thee, O Christ, our loving King,
All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Ant Laudes.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus vir, * qui in lege Dómini meditátur: volúntas ejus pérmanet die ac nocte, et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, semper prosperabúntur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed is the man * that doth meditate in the law of the Lord; his delight is therein day and night, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus iste Sanctus, * qui confísus est in Dómino, prædicávit præcéptum Dómini, constitútus est in monte sancto ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed and holy is he * that putteth his trust in the Lord, that declareth the decree of the Lord, and is set upon His holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es glória mea, * tu es suscéptor meus, Dómine; tu exáltans caput meum, et exaudísti me de monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou, O Lord, art my glory, * Thou art a shield for me; Thou art the Lifter-up of mine head, and Thou hast heard me out of thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invocántem * exaudívit Dóminus Sanctum suum; Dóminus exaudívit eum, et constítuit eum in pace.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When His holy one called, * the Lord heard him, yea, the Lord heard him, and gave him peace.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Læténtur omnes * qui sperant in te, Dómine; quóniam tu benedixísti justo, scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ coronásti eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice, O Lord, for Thou hast blessed the righteous; * Thou hast compassed him with thy favour as with a shield.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra! quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctum tuum, et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, our Ruler, * how excellent is thy Name in all the earth, Who hast crowned thine holy one with glory and honour, and made him to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * iste Sanctus habitábit in tabernáculo tuo, operátus est justítiam, requiéscet in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, this thy Saint * shall dwell in thy tabernacle, and this that hath worked righteousness shall abide upon thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vitam pétiit * a te, et tribuísti ei, Dómine: glóriam et magnum decórem imposuísti super eum; posuísti in cápite ejus corónam de lápide pretióso.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He asked life of thee, * and Thou, O Lord, gavest it; honour and great majesty hast Thou laid upon him; Thou hast set a crown of precious stones upon his head.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hic accípiet * benedictiónem a Dómino, et misericórdiam a Deo salutári suo: quia hæc est generátio quæréntium Dóminum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He shall receive * a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from the God of his salvation, for this is the generation of them that seek the Lord.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Jesu Redémptor ómnium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Jesu Redémptor ómnium,
Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
In hac die cleméntius
Indúlgeas precántibus.

Tui sacri qua nóminis
Conféssor almus cláruit:
Hujus celébrat ánnua
Devóta plebs solémnia.

Qui rite mundi gáudia
Hujus cadúca réspuens,
Æternitátis prǽmio
Potítur inter Ángelos.

Hujus benígnus ánnue
Nobis sequi vestígia:
Hujus precátu, sérvulis
Dimítte noxam críminis.

Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
Tibi, Patríque glória,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;
thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:
Accept with gentlest love today
The prayers and praises that we pay.

The meek confessor of thy name
Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,
Thy faithful people celebrate.

The world and all its boasted good,
As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,
In endless joy forever stands.

Grant then that we, most gracious God,
May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free
From stain of all iniquity.

To thee, O Christ, our loving King,
All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Quem pie laudant pópuli per orbem,
Hac die lætus méruit beátas
Scándere sedes.

Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
Sóbriam duxit sine labe vitam,
Donec humános animávit auræ
Spíritus artus.

Cujus ob præstans méritum, frequénter,
Ægra quæ passim jacuére membra,
Víribus morbi dómitis, salúti
Restituúntur.

Noster hinc illi chorus obsequéntem
Cóncinit laudem celebrésque palmas,
Ut piis ejus précibus juvémur
Omne per ævum.

Sit salus illi, decus atque virtus,
Qui, super cæli sólio corúscans,
Tótius mundi sériem gubérnat,
Trinus et unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
This the confessor of the Lord, whose triumph
Now all the faithful celebrate, with gladness
Erst on this feast-day merited to enter
Into his glory.

Saintly and prudent, modest in behaviour,
Peaceful and sober, chaste was he, and lowly.
While that life’s vigour, coursing through his members,
Quickened his being.

Sick ones of old time, to his tomb resorting,
Sorely by ailments manifold afflicted,
Oft-times have welcomed health and strength returning,
At his petition.

Whence we in chorus gladly do him honour,
Chanting his praises with devout affection,
That in his merits we may have a portion,
Now and forever.

His be the glory, power and salvation,
Who over all things reigneth in the highest,
Earth’s mighty fabric ruling and directing,
Onely and Trinal.
Amen.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Jesu Redémptor ómnium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Jesu Redémptor ómnium,
Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
In hac die cleméntius
Indúlgeas precántibus.

Tui sacri qua nóminis
Conféssor almus cláruit:
Hujus celébrat ánnua
Devóta plebs solémnia.

Qui rite mundi gáudia
Hujus cadúca réspuens,
Æternitátis prǽmio
Potítur inter Ángelos.

Hujus benígnus ánnue
Nobis sequi vestígia:
Hujus precátu, sérvulis
Dimítte noxam críminis.

Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
Tibi, Patríque glória,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;
thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:
Accept with gentlest love today
The prayers and praises that we pay.

The meek confessor of thy name
Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,
Thy faithful people celebrate.

The world and all its boasted good,
As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,
In endless joy forever stands.

Grant then that we, most gracious God,
May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free
From stain of all iniquity.

To thee, O Christ, our loving King,
All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Quem pie laudant pópuli per orbem,
Hac die lætus méruit beátas
Scándere sedes.

Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
Sóbriam duxit sine labe vitam,
Donec humános animávit auræ
Spíritus artus.

Cujus ob præstans méritum, frequénter,
Ægra quæ passim jacuére membra,
Víribus morbi dómitis, salúti
Restituúntur.

Noster hinc illi chorus obsequéntem
Cóncinit laudem celebrésque palmas,
Ut piis ejus précibus juvémur
Omne per ævum.

Sit salus illi, decus atque virtus,
Qui, super cæli sólio corúscans,
Tótius mundi sériem gubérnat,
Trinus et unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
This the confessor of the Lord, whose triumph
Now all the faithful celebrate, with gladness
Erst on this feast-day merited to enter
Into his glory.

Saintly and prudent, modest in behaviour,
Peaceful and sober, chaste was he, and lowly.
While that life’s vigour, coursing through his members,
Quickened his being.

Sick ones of old time, to his tomb resorting,
Sorely by ailments manifold afflicted,
Oft-times have welcomed health and strength returning,
At his petition.

Whence we in chorus gladly do him honour,
Chanting his praises with devout affection,
That in his merits we may have a portion,
Now and forever.

His be the glory, power and salvation,
Who over all things reigneth in the highest,
Earth’s mighty fabric ruling and directing,
Onely and Trinal.
Amen.

Lectio Prima.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. The Lord hath chosen him for a Priest unto Himself.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. Thou art a Priest for ever.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. After the order of Melchisedek.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Gregem tuum, Pastor ætérne, placátus inténde: et, per beátum N. Summum Pontíficem, perpétua protectióne custódi; quem totíus Ecclésiæ præstitísti esse pastórem.
Oratio.eng: Look forgivingly on thy flock, Eternal Shepherd, and keep it in thy constant protection, by the intercession of blessed N. thy Sovereign Pontiff, whom thou didst constitute Shepherd of the whole Church.

℣. Secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
℟. In ætérnum.

℟. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.

℟.br. Thou art a Priest * for ever.
℣. After the order of Melchisedek.
℟. For ever.

℟. Thou art a Priest * for ever.

℣. Ad sacrificándum ei hóstiam laudis.
℟. Sacerdótem sibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.

℣. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.
℟. For a Priest unto Himself.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. The Lord hath chosen him * for a Priest unto Himself.

Ant 1.eng: O thou Priest and Bishop, * thou worker of mighty works, thou good shepherd over God’s people, pray for us unto the Lord.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.
Ant 2.eng: Well done, thou good and faithful servant * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Amávit eum Dóminus, * et ornávit eum: stolam glóriæ índuit eum, et ad portas paradísi coronávit eum.
Ant 3.eng: The Lord loved him * and beautified him. He clothed him with a robe of glory, and crowned him at the gates of Paradise.

Ant 3 summi Pontificis.label: Antiphon
Ant 3 summi Pontificis.lat: Dum esset Summus Póntifex, * terréna non métuit, sed ad cæléstia regna gloriósus migrávit.
Ant 3 summi Pontificis.eng: While he was supreme Pontiff, * he feared not earthly powers, but gloriously went his way to the heavenly kingdom.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Fungi sacerdótio, et habére laudem in nómine ipsíus, et offérre illi incénsum dignum in odórem suavitátis.
Capitulum Nona.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Non est invéntus símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi: ídeo jurejurándo fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: There was not found the like to him in glory, who kept the law of the most High, and was in covenant with him. Therefore by an oath he gave him glory in his posterity, that he should increase in his people.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Jesu Redémptor ómnium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Jesu Redémptor ómnium,
Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
In hac die cleméntius
Indúlgeas precántibus.

Tui sacri qua nóminis
Conféssor almus cláruit:
Hujus celébrat ánnua
Devóta plebs solémnia.

Qui rite mundi gáudia
Hujus cadúca réspuens,
Æternitátis prǽmio
Potítur inter Ángelos.

Hujus benígnus ánnue
Nobis sequi vestígia:
Hujus precátu, sérvulis
Dimítte noxam críminis.

Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
Tibi, Patríque glória,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;
thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:
Accept with gentlest love today
The prayers and praises that we pay.

The meek confessor of thy name
Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,
Thy faithful people celebrate.

The world and all its boasted good,
As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,
In endless joy forever stands.

Grant then that we, most gracious God,
May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free
From stain of all iniquity.

To thee, O Christ, our loving King,
All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Quem pie laudant pópuli per orbem,
Hac die lætus méruit beátas
Scándere sedes.

Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
Sóbriam duxit sine labe vitam,
Donec humános animávit auræ
Spíritus artus.

Cujus ob præstans méritum, frequénter,
Ægra quæ passim jacuére membra,
Víribus morbi dómitis, salúti
Restituúntur.

Noster hinc illi chorus obsequéntem
Cóncinit laudem celebrésque palmas,
Ut piis ejus précibus juvémur
Omne per ævum.

Sit salus illi, decus atque virtus,
Qui, super cæli sólio corúscans,
Tótius mundi sériem gubérnat,
Trinus et unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
This the confessor of the Lord, whose triumph
Now all the faithful celebrate, with gladness
Erst on this feast-day merited to enter
Into his glory.

Saintly and prudent, modest in behaviour,
Peaceful and sober, chaste was he, and lowly.
While that life’s vigour, coursing through his members,
Quickened his being.

Sick ones of old time, to his tomb resorting,
Sorely by ailments manifold afflicted,
Oft-times have welcomed health and strength returning,
At his petition.

Whence we in chorus gladly do him honour,
Chanting his praises with devout affection,
That in his merits we may have a portion,
Now and forever.

His be the glory, power and salvation,
Who over all things reigneth in the highest,
Earth’s mighty fabric ruling and directing,
Onely and Trinal.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.eng: The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Fungi sacerdótio, et habére laudem in nómine ipsíus, et offérre illi incénsum dignum in odórem suavitátis.
Lectio Prima.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. The Lord hath chosen him for a Priest unto Himself.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. Thou art a Priest for ever.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. After the order of Melchisedek.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Da, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut beatórum N. et N. Confessórum tuórum atque Pontíficum veneránda solémnitas, et devotiónem nobis áugeat et salútem.
Oratio.eng: Grant, we beseech thee, almighty God, that the venerable feast of N. thy blessed Confessor and Bishop may increase our devotion and promote our salvation.

Responsory Breve Nona.lat:
℟.br. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.
℣. Secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
℟. In ætérnum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.

℟.br. Thou art a Priest * for ever.
℣. After the order of Melchisedek.
℟. For ever.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Thou art a Priest * for ever.

℟.br. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.
℣. Ad sacrificándum ei hóstiam laudis.
℟. Sacerdótem sibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.
