Capitulum Nona.eng: Many daughters have gathered together riches: thou hast surpassed them all. Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: the woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.

Capitulum Sexta.eng: She hath opened her hand to the needy, and stretched out her hands to the poor. She shall not fear for her house in the cold of snow.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, Rex, et collaudábo te Deum Salvatórem meum. Confitébor nómini tuo: quóniam adjútor et protéctor factus es mihi, et liberásti corpus meum a perditióne.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: I will give glory to thee, O Lord, O King, and I will praise thee, O God my Saviour. I will give glory to thy name: for thou hast been a helper and protector to me, and hast preserved my body from destruction.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Laudábit usque ad mortem ánima mea Dóminum, quóniam éruis sustinéntes te, et líberas eos de manu angústiæ, Dómine, Deus noster.
Capitulum Nona.eng: My soul shall praise the Lord even to death. How thou deliverest them that wait for thee, O Lord, and savest them out of the hands of the nations!

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Liberásti me secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ nóminis tui a rugiéntibus, præparátis ad escam, de mánibus quæréntium ánimam meam, et de multis tribulatiónibus quæ circumdedérunt me.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And thou hast delivered me, according to the multitude of the mercy of thy name, from them that did roar, prepared to devour. Out of the hands of them that sought my life, and from the gates of afflictions, which compassed me about.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Fortem viríli péctore
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Fortem viríli péctore
Laudémus omnes féminam,
Quæ sanctitátis glória
Ubíque fulget ínclita.

Hæc sancto amóre sáucia,
Dum mundi amórem nóxium
Horréscit, ad cæléstia
Iter perégit árduum.

Carnem domans jejúniis,
Dulcíque mentem pábulo
Oratiónis nútriens,
Cæli potítur gáudiis.

Rex Christe, virtus fórtium,
Qui magna solus éfficis,
Hujus precátu, quǽsumus,
Audi benígnus súpplices.

Deo Patri sit glória,
Ejúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
High let us all our voices raise
In that heroic woman's praise
Whose name, with saintly glory bright,
Shines in the starry realms of light.

Filled with a pure celestial glow,
She spurned all love of things below;
And heedless here on earth to stay,
Climbed to the skies her toilsome way.

With fasts her body she subdued,
But filled her soul with prayer's sweet food:
In other worlds she tastes the bliss
For which she left the joys of this.

O Christ, the strength of all the strong;
To whom our holiest deeds belong!
Through her prevailing prayers on high,
In mercy hear thy people's cry!

To God the Father, with the Son,
And Holy Spirit, Three in One,
Be glory while the ages flow,
From all above, and all below.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Hujus orátu, Deus alme, nobis
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Hujus orátu, Deus alme, nobis
Débitas pœnas scélerum remítte;
Ut tibi puro resonémus almum
Péctore carmen.

Sit decus Patri, genitǽque Proli,
Et tibi, compar utriúsque virtus,
Spíritus semper, Deus unus, omni
Témporis ævo.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
Fountain of mercy, hear the prayers she offers;
Purge our offences, pardon our transgressions,
So that hereafter we to thee may render
Praise with thanksgiving.

Thou, the All-Father, thou, the One-Begotten,
Thou, Holy Spirit, Three in One co-equal,
Glory be henceforth thine through all the ages,
World without ending.
Amen.

Oratio.eng: Grant unto us, we beseech thee, O Lord, our God, that we may ever call to mind, with all worship and thanksgiving, the victory of thy holy Martyrs N. and N., and although we know that our mind cannot comprehend thee who art this day their exceeding great reward, give us always the grace humbly to worship thee.

Ant 1.eng: The Most High hath hallowed His Tabernacle. * For this is the House of God, whereon His Name shall be called, whereof it is written My Name shall be there, saith the Lord.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Zachǽe, * festínans descénde, quia hódie in domo tua opórtet me manére. At ille festínans descéndit, et suscépit illum gaudens in domum suam. Hódie huic dómui salus a Deo facta est, allelúja.
Ant 2.eng: Zacchaeus, make haste and come down, for today I must abide at thy house. * And he made haste and came down, and received Him joyfully into his house. This day is salvation come from God to this house. Alleluia.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: O quam metuéndus est * locus iste: vere non est hic áliud, nisi domus Dei, et porta cæli.
Ant 3.eng: How dreadful is this place. * Surely this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Vidi civitátem sanctam, Jerúsalem novam, descendéntem de cælo a Deo, parátam sicut sponsam ornátam viro suo.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a Bride adorned for her husband.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Et abstérget Deus omnem lácrimam ab óculis eórum: et mors ultra non erit, neque luctus, neque clamor, neque dolor erit ultra, quia prima abiérunt. Et dixit qui sedébat in throno: Ecce nova fácio ómnia.
Capitulum Nona.eng: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes, and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain; for the former things are passed away. And He That sat upon the throne said: Behold, I make all things new.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Et audívi vocem magnam de throno dicéntem: Ecce tabernáculum Dei cum homínibus, et habitábit cum eis; et ipsi pópulus ejus erunt, et ipse Deus cum eis erit eórum Deus.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: And I heard a great voice out of the throne, saying Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and He will dwell with them. And they shall be His people; and God Himself shall be with them, and be their God.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Alto ex Olýmpi vértice
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Alto ex Olýmpi vértice
Summi Paréntis Fílius,
Ceu monte deséctus lapis
Terras in imas décidens,
Domus supérnæ et ínfimæ
Utrúmque junxit ángulum.

Sed illa sedes cǽlitum
Semper resúltat láudibus,
Deúmque trinum et únicum
Jugi canóre prǽdicat:
Illi canéntes júngimur
Almæ Siónis ǽmuli.

Hæc templa, Rex cæléstium,
Imple benígno lúmine:
Huc, o rogátus, ádveni,
Plebísque vota súscipe,
Et nostra corda júgiter
Perfúnde cæli grátia.

Hic ímpetrent fidélium
Voces precésque súpplicum
Domus beátæ múnera,
Partísque donis gáudeant:
Donec, solúti córpore,
Sedes beátas ímpleant.

Decus Parénti débitum
Sit usquequáque Altíssimo,
Natóque Patris único,
Et ínclito Paráclito,
Cui laus, potéstas, glória
Ætérna sit per sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
From highest heaven, the Father's Son,
Descending like that mystic stone
Cut from a mountain without hands,
Came down below, and filled all lands;
Uniting, midway in the sky,
His house on earth, and house on high.

That house on high,  it ever rings
With praises of the King of kings;
Forever there, on harps divine,
They hymn th' eternal One and Trine;
We, here below, the strain prolong,
And faintly echo Sion's song.

O Lord of lords invisible!
With thy pure light this temple fill:
Hither, oft as invoked, descend;
Here to thy people's prayer attend;
Here, through all hearts, forevermore,
thy Spirit's quick'ning graces pour.

Here may the faithful, day by day,
Their hearts' adoring homage pay;
And here receive from thy dear love
The blessings of that home above;
Till loosened from this mortal chain,
Its everlasting joys they gain.

To God the Father, glory due
Be paid by all the heavenly host;
And to his only Son most true;
With thee, O mighty Holy Ghost!
To whom, praise, power, and blessing be,
Through th' ages of eternity,
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Cæléstis urbs Jerúsalem
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Cæléstis urbs Jerúsalem,
Beáta pacis vísio,
Quæ celsa de vivéntibus
Saxis ad astra tólleris,
Sponsǽque ritu cíngeris
Mille Angelórum míllibus.

O sorte nupta próspera,
Dotáta Patris glória,
Respérsa Sponsi grátia,
Regína formosíssima,
Christo jugáta Príncipi,
Cæli corúsca cívitas.

Hic margarítis émicant,
Paténtque cunctis óstia;
Virtúte namque prǽvia
Mortális illuc dúcitur,
Amóre Christi pércitus
Torménta quisquis sústinet.

Scalpri salúbris íctibus
Et tunsióne plúrima,
Fabri políta málleo
Hanc saxa molem cónstruunt,
Aptísque juncta néxibus
Locántur in fastígio.

Decus Parénti débitum
Sit usquequáque Altíssimo,
Natóque Patris único,
Et ínclito Paráclito,
Cui laus, potéstas, glória
Ætérna sit per sǽcula.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
Thou heavenly, new Jerusalem,
Vision of peace in prophet's dream!
With living stones built up on high,
And rising to yon starry sky;
In bridal pomp thy form is crowned,
With thousand thousand angels round!

O bride, betrothed in happy hour,
The Father's glory is thy dower;
The bridegroom's grace is shed on thee
Thou queen all fair eternally;
To Christ allied, thy Prince adored,
Bright shining city of the Lord!

Behold with pearls they glittering stand
thy peaceful gates to all expand;
By grace and strength divinely shed
Each mortal thither may be led;
Who, kindled by Christ's love, will dare
All earthly sufferings now to bear.

By many a salutary stroke,
By many a weary blow that broke,
Or polished with a workman's skill,
The stones that form that glorious pile,
They all are fitly framed to lie
In their appointed place on high.

Fair and well pleasing in thy sight,
Parent most high, enthroned in light,
And for thine only Son most meet,
And thee, all-glorious Paraclete,
To whom praise, power, and glory rise
Forever through the eternal skies.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Domum Dei decet sanctitúdo: * Sponsum ejus Christum adorémus in ea.
Invit.eng: Holiness becometh the house of God. * In her let us worship her Bridegroom, even Christ.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Et abstérget Deus omnem lácrimam ab óculis eórum: et mors ultra non erit, neque luctus, neque clamor, neque dolor erit ultra, quia prima abiérunt. Et dixit qui sedébat in throno: Ecce nova fácio ómnia.
Lectio Prima.eng: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes, and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain; for the former things are passed away. And He That sat upon the throne said: Behold, I make all things new.

Nocturn 1 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 1 Versum.eng: ℣. Holiness becometh thine house, O Lord.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. My house.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. Shall be called the house of prayer.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Hæc est domus Dómini fírmiter ædificáta.
Nocturn 3 Versum.latR: ℟. Bene fundáta est supra firmam petram.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. This is the house of God, stoutly builded.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. Well founded upon a sure rock.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, qui nobis per síngulos annos hujus sancti templi tui consecratiónis réparas diem, et sacris semper mystériis repræséntas incólumes: exáudi preces pópuli tui, et præsta; ut quisquis hoc templum benefícia petitúrus ingréditur, cuncta se impetrásse lætétur.
Oratio.eng: O God, who dost every year bring round unto us again the day whereon this thine holy temple was hallowed, and bringest us again in soundness of body and mind to be present at thine holy worship, graciously hear the supplications of thy people, and grant that whosoever shall come into this thine house to ask good at thine hand, may be rejoiced in the obtaining of all his request.

Responsory Breve Nona.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Nona.lat:
℟.br. Hæc est domus Dómini * Fírmiter ædificáta.
℣. Bene fundáta est supra firmam petram.
℟. Fírmiter ædificáta.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Hæc est domus Dómini * Fírmiter ædificáta.
Responsory Breve Nona.eng:
℟.br. This is the Lord's house, * stoutly builded.
℣. Well founded upon a sure rock.
℟. Stoutly builded.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. This is the Lord's house, * stoutly builded.

Responsory Breve Sexta.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Sexta.lat:
℟.br. Locus iste sanctus est, * In quo orat sacérdos.
℣. Pro delíctis et peccátis pópuli.
℟. In quo orat sacérdos.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Locus iste sanctus est, * In quo orat sacérdos.
Responsory Breve Sexta.eng:
℟.br. This place is holy, * wherein the Priest prayeth.
℣. For the pardon of the transgressions and offences of the people.
℟. The Priest prayeth.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. This place is holy, * wherein the Priest prayeth.

Responsory Breve Tertia.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Tertia.lat:
℟.br. Domum tuam, Dómine, * Decet sanctitúdo.
℣. In longitúdinem diérum.
℟. Decet sanctitúdo.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Domum tuam, Domine, * Decet sanctitudo.
Responsory Breve Tertia.eng:
℟.br. Holiness becometh thine house, * O Lord.
℣. For ever.
℟. O Lord.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Holiness becometh thine house, * O Lord.

Ant Laudes.antEng: All thy walls are of stones most precious, * and the towers of Jerusalem shall be built up with jewels.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tóllite portas, * príncipes vestras, et elevámini, portæ æternáles.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lift up your gates, O ye princes, * and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Erit mihi Dóminus * in Deum, et lapis iste vocábitur domus Dei.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Lord shall be my God, * and this stone shall be called God's house.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Ædificávit * Móyses altáre Dómino Deo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Moses built an altar * to the Lord God.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Non est hic áliud, * nisi domus Dei, et porta cæli.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: This is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vidit Jacob scalam, * súmmitas ejus cælos tangébat, et descendéntes Angelos, et dixit: Vere locus iste sanctus est.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Jacob beheld a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven, and the angels of God descending on it. And he said: Surely this place is holy.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Eréxit Jacob * lápidem in títulum, fundens óleum désuper.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Jacob set up the stone for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Qui hábitat * in adjutório Altíssimi, in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He that dwelleth in the help of the Most High * shall abide under the shadow of the God of heaven.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Templum Dómini * sanctum est, Dei structúra est, Dei ædificátio est.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Temple of the Lord is holy. * The same is God's workmanship and God's building.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Benedícta * glória Dómini, de loco sancto suo, allelúja.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed be the glory of the Lord * from His holy place. Alleluia.

Ant Vespera.antEng: All thy walls are of stones most precious, * and the towers of Jerusalem shall be built up with jewels.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Omne * quod dat mihi Pater, ad me véniet; et eum qui venit ad me, non eíciam foras.
Ant 1.eng: All that the Father giveth Me shall come to Me; * and him that cometh to Me I will in no wise cast out.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Ego sum * resurréctio et vita: qui credit in me, étiam si mórtuus fúerit, vivet; et omnis qui vivit et credit in me, non moriétur in ætérnum.
Ant 2.eng: I am the resurrection and the life: * he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live; and whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.lat: Regem, cui ómnia vivunt, * Veníte adorémus.
Invit.eng: Unto the Eternal King all live. * O come, let us worship Him.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. May the Lord set them with princes;
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. Even with the princes of his people.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Ne tradas béstiis ánimas confiténtes tibi.
Nocturn 3 Versum.latR: ℟. Et ánimas páuperum tuórum ne obliviscáris in finem.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. O deliver not unto beasts the souls of them that praise thee!
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. And forget not the souls of thy poor for ever.

Oratio 1.label: Oratio
Oratio 1.lat: Fidélium, Deus, ómnium Cónditor et Redémptor, animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum remissiónem cunctórum tríbue peccatórum: ut indulgéntiam, quam semper optavérunt, piis supplicatiónibus consequántur:
Oratio 1.eng: O God, who art thyself at once the Maker and the Redeemer of all thy faithful ones, grant unto the souls of thy servants and handmaids remission of all their sins, making of our entreaties unto our great Father a mean whereby they may have that forgiveness which they have ever hoped for.

Ant Laudes.ant: Exsultábunt Dómino * ossa humiliáta.
Ant Laudes.antEng: The bones which thou hast broken * may rejoice.

Ant Laudes.ant: Exáudi, Dómine, * oratiónem meam: ad te omnis caro véniet.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Lord, hear * my prayer; unto thee shall all flesh come.

Ant Laudes.ant: Me suscépit * déxtera tua, Dómine.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Thy right hand * upholdeth me.

Ant Laudes.ant: A porta ínferi * érue, Dómine, ánimam meam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: From the gates of hell * deliver my soul, O Lord.

Ant Laudes.ant: Omnis spíritus * laudet Dóminum.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Let everything that hath breath * praise the Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dírige, * Dómine, Deus meus, in conspéctu tuo viam meam.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Make my way straight before thy face, * O Lord my God.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Convértere, * Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: quóniam non est in morte, qui memor sit tui.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul * O save me for thy mercy's sake.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Nequándo rápiat * ut leo ánimam meam, dum non est qui rédimat, neque qui salvum fáciat.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, * while there is none to deliver, or to save.

Ant Matutinum.ant: In loco páscuæ * ibi me collocávit.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He maketh me to lie down * in green pastures.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Delícta * juventútis meæ, et ignorántias meas ne memíneris, Dómine.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, remember not the sins of my youth, * nor my transgressions.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Credo vidére * bona Dómini in terra vivéntium.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: I believe that I shall yet see the goodness of the Lord * in the land of the living.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Compláceat * tibi, Dómine, ut erípias me: Dómine, ad adjuvándum me réspice.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me * O Lord, look upon me to help me.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sana, Dómine, * ánimam meam, quia peccávi tibi.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, heal my soul; * for I have sinned against thee.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Sitívit * ánima mea ad Deum vivum: quando véniam, et apparébo ante fáciem Dómini?
Ant Matutinum.antEng: My soul thirsteth for the living God; * when shall I come and appear before God?

Ant Vespera.ant: Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.
Ant Vespera.antEng: I will walk before the Lord * in the land of the living.

Ant Vespera.ant: Heu mihi Dómine, * quia incolátus meus prolongátus est.
Ant Vespera.antEng: Woe is me! O Lord, * that my sojourn is long

Ant Vespera.ant: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
Ant Vespera.antEng: The Lord shall keep thee from all evil, * the Lord shall keep thy soul.

Ant Vespera.ant: Si iniquitátes * observáveris, Dómine: Dómine, quis sustinébit?
Ant Vespera.antEng: If Thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, * O Lord, who shall stand.

Ant Vespera.ant: Opera * mánuum tuárum, Dómine, ne despícias.
Ant Vespera.antEng: O Lord, forsake not * the works of thine own hands.

Ant 1.label: Antiphon
Ant 1.lat: Sacérdos et Póntifex, * et virtútum ópifex, pastor bone in pópulo, ora pro nobis Dóminum.
Ant 1.eng: O thou Priest and Bishop, * thou worker of mighty works, thou good shepherd over God’s people, pray for us unto the Lord.

Ant 2.label: Antiphon
Ant 2.lat: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.
Ant 2.eng: Well done, thou good and faithful servant * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

Ant 3.label: Antiphon
Ant 3.lat: Dum esset Summus Póntifex, * terréna non métuit, sed ad cæléstia regna gloriósus migrávit.
Ant 3.eng: While he was supreme Pontiff, * he feared not earthly powers, but gloriously went his way to the heavenly kingdom.

Ant 3 summi Pontificis.label: Antiphon
Ant 3 summi Pontificis.lat: Dum esset Summus Póntifex, * terréna non métuit, sed ad cæléstia regna gloriósus migrávit.
Ant 3 summi Pontificis.eng: While he was supreme Pontiff, * he feared not earthly powers, but gloriously went his way to the heavenly kingdom.

Capitulum Laudes.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Laudes.lat: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
Capitulum Laudes.eng: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

Capitulum Nona.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Nona.lat: Fungi sacerdótio, et habére laudem in nómine ipsíus, et offérre illi incénsum dignum in odórem suavitátis.
Capitulum Nona.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Capitulum Sexta.label: Capitulum
Capitulum Sexta.lat: Non est invéntus símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi: ídeo jurejurándo fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Capitulum Sexta.eng: There was not found the like to him in glory, who kept the law of the most High, and was in covenant with him. Therefore by an oath he gave him glory in his posterity, that he should increase in his people.

Hymnus Laudes.label: Hymn
Hymnus Laudes.title: Jesu Redémptor ómnium
Hymnus Laudes.lat:
Jesu Redémptor ómnium,
Perpes coróna Prǽsulum,
In hac die cleméntius
Indúlgeas precántibus.

Tui sacri qua nóminis
Conféssor almus cláruit:
Hujus celébrat ánnua
Devóta plebs solémnia.

Qui rite mundi gáudia
Hujus cadúca réspuens,
Æternitátis prǽmio
Potítur inter Ángelos.

Hujus benígnus ánnue
Nobis sequi vestígia:
Hujus precátu, sérvulis
Dimítte noxam críminis.

Sit Christe, Rex piíssime,
Tibi, Patríque glória,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc, et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
Hymnus Laudes.eng:
Jesu, the world’s Redeemer, O hear;
thy bishops’ fadeless crown, draw near:
Accept with gentlest love today
The prayers and praises that we pay.

The meek confessor of thy name
Today attained a glorious fame;
Whose yearly feast, in solemn state,
Thy faithful people celebrate.

The world and all its boasted good,
As vain and passing, he eschewed;
And therefore with angelic bands,
In endless joy forever stands.

Grant then that we, most gracious God,
May follow in the steps he trod:
And, at his prayer, thy servants free
From stain of all iniquity.

To thee, O Christ, our loving King,
All glory, praise, and thanks we bring:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.

Hymnus Matutinum.label: Hymn
Hymnus Matutinum.title: Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Hymnus Matutinum.lat:
Iste Conféssor Dómini, coléntes
Quem pie laudant pópuli per orbem,
Hac die lætus méruit beátas
Scándere sedes.

Qui pius, prudens, húmilis, pudícus,
Sóbriam duxit sine labe vitam,
Donec humános animávit auræ
Spíritus artus.

Cujus ob præstans méritum, frequénter,
Ægra quæ passim jacuére membra,
Víribus morbi dómitis, salúti
Restituúntur.

Noster hinc illi chorus obsequéntem
Cóncinit laudem celebrésque palmas,
Ut piis ejus précibus juvémur
Omne per ævum.

Sit salus illi, decus atque virtus,
Qui, super cæli sólio corúscans,
Tótius mundi sériem gubérnat,
Trinus et unus.
Amen.
Hymnus Matutinum.eng:
This the confessor of the Lord, whose triumph
Now all the faithful celebrate, with gladness
Erst on this feast-day merited to enter
Into his glory.

Saintly and prudent, modest in behaviour,
Peaceful and sober, chaste was he, and lowly.
While that life’s vigour, coursing through his members,
Quickened his being.

Sick ones of old time, to his tomb resorting,
Sorely by ailments manifold afflicted,
Oft-times have welcomed health and strength returning,
At his petition.

Whence we in chorus gladly do him honour,
Chanting his praises with devout affection,
That in his merits we may have a portion,
Now and forever.

His be the glory, power and salvation,
Who over all things reigneth in the highest,
Earth’s mighty fabric ruling and directing,
Onely and Trinal.
Amen.

Invit.label: Antiphon
Invit.eng: The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

Lectio Prima.label: Lectio brevis
Lectio Prima.lat: Fungi sacerdótio, et habére laudem in nómine ipsíus, et offérre illi incénsum dignum in odórem suavitátis.
Lectio Prima.eng: To execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name. He chose him out of all men living, to offer sacrifice to God, incense, and a good savour.

Nocturn 2 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 2 Versum.eng: ℣. The Lord hath chosen him for a Priest unto Himself.
Nocturn 2 Versum.engR: ℟. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.

Nocturn 3 Versum.label: Versicle
Nocturn 3 Versum.lat: ℣. Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum.
Nocturn 3 Versum.eng: ℣. Thou art a Priest for ever.
Nocturn 3 Versum.engR: ℟. After the order of Melchisedek.

Oratio.label: Oratio
Oratio.lat: Deus, ómnium fidélium pastor et rector, fámulum tuum N.p, quem pastórem Ecclésiæ tuæ præésse voluísti, propítius réspice: da ei, quǽsumus, verbo et exémplo, quibus præest, profícere; ut ad vitam, una cum grege sibi crédito, pervéniat sempitérnam.
Oratio.eng: Deus, ómnium fidélium pastor et rector, fámulum tuum N.p, quem pastórem Ecclésiæ tuæ præésse voluísti, propítius réspice: da ei, quǽsumus, verbo et exémplo, quibus præest, profícere; ut ad vitam, una cum grege sibi crédito, pervéniat sempitérnam.

Responsory Breve Nona.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Nona.lat:
℟.br. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.
℣. Secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
℟. In ætérnum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Tu es sacérdos * In ætérnum.
Responsory Breve Nona.eng:
℟.br. Thou art a Priest * for ever.
℣. After the order of Melchisedek.
℟. For ever.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Thou art a Priest * for ever.

Responsory Breve Sexta.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Sexta.lat:
℟.br. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.
℣. Ad sacrificándum ei hóstiam laudis.
℟. Sacerdótem sibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Elégit eum Dóminus * Sacerdótem sibi.
Responsory Breve Sexta.eng:
℟.br. The Lord hath chosen him * for a Priest unto Himself.
℣. To offer up unto Him the sacrifice of praise.
℟. For a Priest unto Himself.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. The Lord hath chosen him * for a Priest unto Himself.

Responsory Breve Tertia.label: Responsorium Breve
Responsory Breve Tertia.lat:
℟.br. Amávit eum Dóminus, * Et ornávit eum.
℣. Stolam glóriæ índuit eum.
℟. Et ornávit eum.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Amávit eum Dóminus, * Et ornávit eum.
Responsory Breve Tertia.eng:
℟.br. The Lord loved him, * and beautified him.
℣. He clothed him with a robe of glory.
℟. And beautified him.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. The Lord loved him, * and beautified him.

Gloria
Credo

Versum 1.label: Versicle
Versum 1.lat: ℣. Amávit eum Dóminus, et ornávit eum.
Versum 1.latR: ℟. Stolam glóriæ índuit eum.
Versum 1.eng: ℣. The Lord loved him and beautified him.
Versum 1.engR: ℟. He clothed him with a robe of glory.

Versum 2.label: Versicle
Versum 2.lat: ℣. Justum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
Versum 2.eng: ℣. The Lord guided the just in right paths.
Versum 2.engR: ℟. And showed him the kingdom of God.

Versum 3.label: Versicle

Ant Laudes.ant: Ecce sacérdos magnus, * qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est justus.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Behold an high priest, * who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous.

Ant Laudes.ant: Non est invéntus * símilis illi, qui conserváret legem Excélsi.
Ant Laudes.antEng: None was found like unto him, * to keep the Law of the Most High.

Ant Laudes.ant: Ideo jurejurándo * fecit illum Dóminus créscere in plebem suam.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Therefore the Lord assured him * by an oath that He would multiply his seed among His people.

Ant Laudes.ant: Sacerdótes Dei, * benedícite Dóminum: servi Dómini, hymnum dícite Deo. Allelúja.
Ant Laudes.antEng: O all ye Priests of God, * bless ye the Lord O all ye servants of the Lord, sing praises unto our God.

Ant Laudes.ant: Serve bone * et fidélis, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
Ant Laudes.antEng: Good and faithful servant, * enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus vir, * qui in lege Dómini meditátur: volúntas ejus pérmanet die ac nocte, et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, semper prosperabúntur.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed is the man * that doth meditate in the law of the Lord; his delight is therein day and night, and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Beátus iste Sanctus, * qui confísus est in Dómino, prædicávit præcéptum Dómini, constitútus est in monte sancto ejus.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Blessed and holy is he * that putteth his trust in the Lord, that declareth the decree of the Lord, and is set upon His holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Tu es glória mea, * tu es suscéptor meus, Dómine; tu exáltans caput meum, et exaudísti me de monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Thou, O Lord, art my glory, * Thou art a shield for me; Thou art the Lifter-up of mine head, and Thou hast heard me out of thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Invocántem * exaudívit Dóminus Sanctum suum; Dóminus exaudívit eum, et constítuit eum in pace.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: When His holy one called, * the Lord heard him, yea, the Lord heard him, and gave him peace.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Læténtur omnes * qui sperant in te, Dómine; quóniam tu benedixísti justo, scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ coronásti eum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice, O Lord, for Thou hast blessed the righteous; * Thou hast compassed him with thy favour as with a shield.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra! quia glória et honóre coronásti Sanctum tuum, et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: O Lord, our Ruler, * how excellent is thy Name in all the earth, Who hast crowned thine holy one with glory and honour, and made him to have dominion over the works of thy hands.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Dómine, * iste Sanctus habitábit in tabernáculo tuo, operátus est justítiam, requiéscet in monte sancto tuo.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: Lord, this thy Saint * shall dwell in thy tabernacle, and this that hath worked righteousness shall abide upon thy holy hill.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Vitam pétiit * a te, et tribuísti ei, Dómine: glóriam et magnum decórem imposuísti super eum; posuísti in cápite ejus corónam de lápide pretióso.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He asked life of thee, * and Thou, O Lord, gavest it; honour and great majesty hast Thou laid upon him; Thou hast set a crown of precious stones upon his head.

Ant Matutinum.ant: Hic accípiet * benedictiónem a Dómino, et misericórdiam a Deo salutári suo: quia hæc est generátio quæréntium Dóminum.
Ant Matutinum.antEng: He shall receive * a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from the God of his salvation, for this is the generation of them that seek the Lord.
